network.body: Txhua tus phooj ywg tuav ib tus neeg kos npe. Cov neeg siv khoom txheeb xyuas ua ntej sib txuas, nodes ua pov thawj cov tswv cuab ntawm kev sau npe. Tsis muaj lub hauv paus tswj hwm tuaj yeem ua tus lej crypto txiaj uas twb tau lees paub lawm.

security.check_auth: Response authenticity — tsis yooj yim sua forge /v1/nodes yam tsis muaj tus maub los tus yuam sij ntiag tug.

security.check_transport: Kev ceev ntiag tug - kev sib txuas URL pom rau koj ISP / Cloudflare. Siv daim iav Tor yog tias metadata tseem ceeb.
security.check_content: Cov ntsiab lus — NOT kov los ntawm tus maub los. End-to-end encrypted ntawm cov neeg siv. Tus tswj tsis tuaj yeem nyeem tsis muaj dab tsi txawm tias muaj kev cuam tshuam tag nrho.

architexDocs.title: Architex Lus Reference
architexDocs.subtitle: Cov lus tshaj tawm UI lus rau Vortex Mini Apps. Reactive xeev, composable layouts, xoom tsim kauj ruam.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex yog ib qho kev tshaj tawm me me DSL tsim los rau nkoj UI hauv Vortex tub txib. Koj piav qhia qhov screen yuav tsum zoo li cas; lub sijhawm ua haujlwm khaws pixels hauv sync nrog lub xeev tau txais. Tsis muaj virtual DOM, tsis muaj pob, tsis muaj JSX — cov ntaub ntawv `.arx` yog lub app.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Tshaj tawm - koj sau UI koj xav tau, tsis yog cov kauj ruam los tsim nws
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~ suav += 1` thiab txhua daim ntawv lo uas nyeem nws hloov tshiab hauv qhov chaw
architexDocs.goalPortable: Portable — tib '.arx' khiav ntawm lub vev xaib, iOS, thiab Android runtimes yam tsis muaj kev hloov kho
architexDocs.goalTiny: Me me - parser + renderer nkoj hauv qis dua 30 KB, yog li Mini Apps qhib tam sim
architexDocs.goalReadable: Nyeem tau - indentation yog qauv; modifiers yog chained nrog `::`; tsis muaj ntawv sau se
architexDocs.whoDesc: Txhua tus neeg uas xav xa ib qho screen sib tham sib hauv Vortex - cov neeg siv cov ntawv, dashboards, nplooj ntawv pov npav, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Yog tias koj tau sau HTML+CSS+JS, Architex yuav hnov ​​​​zoo tab sis sau nrawm dua. Yog tias koj tsis muaj, Architex kuj yog ib qho kev qhia me me rau kev ua haujlwm zoo vim hais tias cov lus ua rau tus hneev taw me me.
architexDocs.howToRead: Yuav ua li cas nyeem cov ntaub ntawv no
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Txhua ntu tsim ntawm ib qho ua ntej. Pib ntawm Quick Start, mam li nyeem Syntax, State, Layout, Modifiers, Actions, thiab qib siab kawg kawg. Dhia ncig ntawm lub rooj ntawm cov ntsiab lus yog tias koj twb paub React lossis Svelte - cov ntsiab lus qhia kom huv.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Txoj kev luv tshaj plaws los ntawm cov ntaub ntawv dawb paug mus rau kev khiav Mini App.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Nyob zoo

  ~npe = "world"

  col :: pad(24) gap(12) center

    header "Nyob zoo, {~name}!" :: Loj loj (28)

    input ~name :: pad(8) radius(6) ciam teb(#ccc)

    ntawv "Tau lub npe saum toj no - cov ntawv no hloov kho thaum koj ntaus."
      :: size(12) xim(#888)
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` tshaj tawm lub hauv paus. `~name = "world"` tsim ib qho kev hloov pauv hloov pauv. `col`, 'header', 'input', 'text' yog built-in Cheebtsam. `::` txuas cov hloov pauv (padding, xim, loj). Thaum tus neeg siv hom nkag mus rau hauv cov tswv yim, txhua '{~name}` hloov pauv hloov tshiab - tsis muaj xov, tsis muaj npe, tsis muaj tes.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Qhib Architex tab nyob rau hauv Vortex bot studio, muab tshuaj txhuam code, nias Khiav. Lub runtime renders rau hauv lub pane saib ua ntej thiab kub-reloads ntawm txuag. Thaum koj tshaj tawm, koj cov neeg siv qhib lub app los ntawm kev sib tham - tsis muaj kev teeb tsa.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Txhua qhov kev pab cuam Architex yog tsim los ntawm plaub yam: tshaj tawm uas pib nrog '@', reactive variables prefixed nrog '~', Cheebtsam sau li liab qab identifiers, thiab modifiers txuas tom qab `::`.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@screen Name`, `@theme`, `@import “./lib.arx”`, thiab `@rau cov khoom hauv ~list` txhua yam pib hauv kab 0. Txhua yam indented hauv qab lawv yog rau qhov thaiv ntawd.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Cheebtsam zaum ntawm lawv tus kheej kab: 'text', 'khawm', 'duab', 'header', 'label', 'badge', 'divider', 'col', 'kab'. Lawv qhov kev sib cav qhov chaw tuaj tom qab lub npe: 'text ~ message', 'khawm "Txuag", `image "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Tom qab '::' koj tuaj yeem saws ntau qhov hloov pauv raws li koj nyiam. Txhua qhov yuav siv xoom lossis ntau qhov sib cav hauv kab lus: `:: pad(24) qhov sib txawv (16) nruab nrab qhov loj me (20) xim (#4f8ef7)`. Cov kev hloov kho yog qhov chaw, tsis yog lo lus tseem ceeb - kev txiav txim tsis muaj teeb meem tshwj tsis yog rau cov neeg sau ntawv kawg-yeej xws li 'xim'.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` ntawm ib lub pob (lossis ib qho kev sib tham sib tham) khiav haujlwm lossis kev hu xovtooj uas ua raws. Ntau "=>" saw ib sab-los-sab: "khawm "Submit" => ~busy = tseeb => xa (kev nqis tes ua: "txuag", cov ntaub ntawv: ~form)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Txhua lub npe ua ntej nrog '~' yog lub cell reactive. Sau `~ suav = 0` tshaj tawm, `~ suav = 5` rov muab, `~ suav += 1` hloov tshiab. Txhua qhov UI node uas nyeem lub xovtooj - ncaj qha lossis los ntawm kev cuam tshuam - rov ua dua thaum lub xovtooj hloov pauv.
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Siv ':=' es tsis txhob '=' tshaj tawm cov lus qhia suav: `~ tag nrho := ~ suav * ~ kauj ruam`. Sab xis-sab rov ntsuas dua thaum twg muaj kev hloov pauv hloov. Tsis muaj phau ntawv sau npe thiab tsis muaj kab laum-tus nqi - yog tias koj nyeem '~a' qhov chaw hauv qhov kev qhia, koj cia li nyob ntawm nws.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Cov lus piav qhia yog xaiv tau tab sis pab nrog autocomplete thiab cov lus yuam kev: `~ suav: naj npawb = 0`, `~name: hlua = ""`, `~ok: boolean = cuav`, `~ khoom: array = []`, `~user: object = {}`. Yog hais tias koj hla lawv hom yog inferred los ntawm lub initialiser.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: 'number', 'string', 'boolean', 'array', 'object', 'null'. Hnub thiab blobs tau dhau los ua cov hlua thiab khoom raws li. Lub sijhawm ua haujlwm siv JavaScript txoj cai yuam kev hauv qab lub hood, yog li '~ suav + 1' ua haujlwm txawm tias '~ suav' pib lub neej raws li txoj hlua.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Txhua txoj hlua tuaj yeem kos cov kab lus nrog `{...}`: `"Nyob zoo, {~user.name}!"`, `"Tag nrho: {~ suav * ~ nqi}"`. Interpolation yeej ib txwm reactive.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex muaj ob lub thawv ntim khoom thiab lub kaum ob nplooj. Zes lawv nrog indentation - tsis muaj kaw tag.
architexDocs.containersDesc: 'col' stacks me nyuam vertically, 'kab' horizontally. Ob leeg lees txais 'gap(n)', 'pad(n)', 'center', 'loj', thiab qhov dav / qhov siab hloov kho. Indent me nyuam ib theem tob rau zes.
architexDocs.containerExample:
kab :: gap(8) pad(16) center
  duab "/avatar.png" :: w(40) h(40) radius(20)
  col :: loj hlob gap(2)
    text ~name :: bold
    text ~ bio :: size(12) xim(#888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: 'text' — ib lub cev luam. 'header' - semantically ib nqe lus. 'label' — cov ntawv sau me me. 'khawm' - coj mus rhaub tau tswj. 'input' — cov ntawv teb khi rau ib qho reactive var. ' duab' — duab los ntawm ib qho URL. 'badge' — ntsiav tshuaj zoo li tag. 'divider' — nyias nyias nyias kab. 'toast' - ephemeral snackbar. 'tab' / 'tab' — tab switcher.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: `text "Hello"` renders ib txoj hlua zoo li qub. 'text ~ message' renders ib reactive ib. Ua ke nrog interpolation: `text "Tag nrho: {~ suav}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Cov ntawv sau. Defaults rau loj, bold dua 'text'. Tib txoj hauj lwm sib cav: 'header "Settings"`. Qhov luaj li cas nrog lub vijtsam — override nrog 'size(n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Kais-muaj peev xwm. Txoj hlua positional yog daim ntawv lo; qhov `=>` ua haujlwm khiav ntawm kais. `khawm "Txuag" => ~draft = null`. Ntau `=>` hluav taws nyob rau hauv kev txiav txim.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Ob-txoj kev-bound text teb. Lub reactive variable tom qab lub npe tuav tus nqi tam sim no: 'input ~email'. Modifiers: `placeholder("…")`, `debounce(300)` rau throttled tshiab.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Loads los ntawm ib qho HTTPS URL lossis `/uploads/...` txoj kev. Hloov kho `w(px)`, `h(px)`, `radius(px)` luas lub thawv. Poob rov qab mus rau qhov chaw silhouette yog tias URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Hairline cais, 1px, hwm lub ntsiab xim tam sim no. Tsis muaj lus sib cav.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Cov tshuaj uas khawm nws cov ntsiab lus: 'paj npe ~ suav', 'paj npe "tshiab"'. Siv rau cov txee uas tsis tau nyeem thiab daim ntawv cim npe.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Caption/pab ntawv nyeem — visually subdued. Good rau daim ntawv teev npe.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Kev ceeb toom tsis thaiv. 'toast ~ pom "Txuag!" :: duration(2000)` qhia rau 2 s thaum twg '~ pom' yog qhov tseeb, ces nws pib tso tawm. Tsis muaj modal stacking, tsis muaj z-index wars.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Tab ntim khi rau ib txoj hlua reactive: 'tabs ~ activeTab'. Hauv nws, txhua lub 'tab "Label" "key"` tshaj tawm ib tab; lub cev indented hauv qab yog qhia thaum qhov tseem ceeb ntais ntawv.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Modifiers yog tib txoj hauv kev los tsim ib qho khoom. Chain lawv tom qab `::`. Lawv tuaj nyob rau hauv tsib tsev neeg: qhov sib nrug, qhov loj me, xim, typography, thiab tus cwj pwm.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` — padding rau txhua sab. `pad(x, y)` — kab rov tav + ntsug. `pad(sab saum toj, sab xis, hauv qab, sab laug)` — CSS-order. `gap(n)` — qhov chaw nruab nrab ntawm cov me nyuam ntawm ib tug 'col' / 'kab'. `margin(n)` — sab nraud ntawm cov kwv tij.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` — taag dav. `h(px)` — taag qhov siab. 'loj' — sau qhov chaw seem hauv kab / col. 'center' - nruab nrab ntawm tus ntoo khaub lig axis; nyob rau hauv ib tug 'col' nws centers horizontally, nyob rau hauv ib tug 'kab' nws centers vertically.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `color(#rrggbb)` — pem hauv ntej. `bg(#rrggbb)` — keeb kwm. Ob leeg lees txais cov ntsiab lus tokens: 'xim (~ thawj)' nyeem los ntawm qhov tam sim no '@ ntsiab' thaiv. Opacity mus dhau 8 tus lej hex: `#00000080` yog 50%% dub.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `size(px)` — font size. 'bold' / 'italic' - hnyav thiab style. `align(left|center|right)` — ntawv nyeem alignment.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `hidden(~flag)` — unmounts node thaum tus chij muaj tseeb. 'pom (~ chij)' — inverse. Unmounted nodes tso lawv DOM, yog li kev cai UI pheej yig.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce(ms)` ntawm 'input' throttles hloov tshiab. `placeholder("…")` qhia ib txoj hlua hint. `format(kind, arg)` on `text` formats a number: `format("currency", "USD")`, `format("percent")`, `format("compact")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius(px)` rounds ces kaum. `border(#rrggbb)` rub 1 px stroke. `border(px, #rrggbb)` teem tuab heev.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Kev ua hloov pauv lub xeev lossis tham nrog lub ntiaj teb sab nraud. Lawv khiav synchronously hauv kais / keypress handler.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~ suav = 0`, `=> ~busy = tseeb`, `=> ~list = []`. Txhua qhov sib txawv reactive yog sau tau.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~ suav += 1` yog idiomatic rau cov txee.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: Ntau `=>` ntawm tib kab hluav taws kub sab saum toj-rau-hauv qab hauv tib zuam, yog li UI hloov tshiab ib zaug thaum kawg: `khawm "Buy" => ~busy = tseeb => xa (ua haujlwm: "yuav") => ~busy = cuav`. Rau kev ua haujlwm async, xav kom suav nrog '@reaction'.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `xa (kev nqis tes ua: "lub npe", ...args)' yog tus choj rov qab mus rau bot. Tus tswv tsev (Vortex runtime) tau txais nws li JSON RPC lus thiab tuaj yeem hu rau koj tus lej bot. Siv nws rau kev nkag mus, API fetches, kev them nyiaj - txhua yam uas DSL nws tus kheej tsis tuaj yeem nthuav qhia.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto("ScreenName", arg: tus nqi, ...)` thawb lwm '@screen' mus rau pawg; `back()` pops. Lub runtime animates los ntawm lub neej ntawd.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~text)`, `haptic("light" | "medium" | "heavy")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("…")`, `confirm("…") => ~ok = it' — lub 'it' shorthand yog tus nqi rov qab ntawm qhov kev qhia ua ntej.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Tshaj tawm ib lub palette ib zaug, rov siv txhua qhov chaw. Tokens dhau los ua qhov hloov pauv tsis tu ncua yog li koj lub app tuaj yeem xa mus rau hom tsaus nti toggle hauv peb kab.
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` rub txhua '@component' thiab '@screen' los ntawm cov ntaub ntawv ntawd rau hauv qhov tam sim no. Txoj kev yog txheeb ze rau cov ntaub ntawv importing; ncig ntshuam raug kuaj pom thiab tshaj tawm ntawm lub sijhawm sib cais.
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Txhais ib zaug, siv ntau zaus: `@component Avatar url size\n duab url :: w(size) h(size) radius(size / 2)`. Nyob rau hauv lub cev tivthaiv lub npe tsis muaj nyob rau hauv raws li dawb identifiers (tsis muaj '~').
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@rau cov khoom hauv ~ npe` ua ib kab rau ib lub caij. `@rau cov khoom, idx hauv ~ daim ntawv teev npe` kuj khi qhov zero-based index. Lub sijhawm ua haujlwm taug qab tus kheej ntawm lub caij nws tus kheej, yog li ntxiv cov khoom nyob rau sab saum toj ntawm 10 000-kab npe nqi O(1) DOM ua haujlwm.
architexDocs.forExample:
@rau cov khoom, idx hauv ~ khoom
  kab :: gap(8) pad(4)
    paib ~idx
    text ~item :: loj
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: 'cond? a : b` ua haujlwm nyob qhov twg qhov kev qhia tau txais. Zes rau enums: `~ xwm txheej>= 10 ? "high": ~status >= 5 ? "mid": "low"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Hauv cov lus tshaj tawm, 'slot' cim qhov chaw hu lub cev ntsaws rau hauv. Xav tias nws yog React cov me nyuam / Vue default slot.
architexDocs.reactivity: Yuav ua li cas reactivity ua haujlwm
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: Txhua '~var' yog lub teeb liab. Thaum koj nyeem nws hauv kev suav, hloov kho kev sib cav, lossis kev cuam tshuam, lub sijhawm ua haujlwm sau ntawv nyeem nyob rau hauv daim duab tam sim no. Thaum koj sau ntawv, txhua qhov ntawm cov ntawv nyeem nws tau rov ntsuas dua - ib zaug, thaum kawg ntawm microtask tam sim no.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Ntau cov ntawv sau nyob rau hauv tib tus handler yog batched. `=> ~a = 1 => ~ b = 2` ua rau ib qho render pass.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Los ntawm lub neej ntawd lub sijhawm khiav siv nruj sib npaug (`===`). Sau tus nqi qub rov ua tsis muaj dab tsi. Hla ib yam khoom tshiab / array kom yuam kev hloov tshiab; immutability yog txhawb tab sis tsis tas yuav tsum tau.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Plaub canonical apps, txhua tus kheej muaj thiab hauv qab 40 kab. Luam ib qho ntawm lawv rau hauv Architex tab thiab nias Run.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Counter - reactive xeev, xam, khawm handlers, ntawv khi.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo — sau rendering, ntxiv / tshem tawm, inline kho.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profile - duab, paib, qhov pom kev pom, navigation.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Killer nta - cov ntsiab lus, imports, tabs, toasts, formatted tooj, ternaries, ntaus vars.
architexDocs.errors: Feem ntau yuam kev thiab yuav ua li cas
architexDocs.errUnknownName: 'tsis paub lub npe ~ foo' - koj siv qhov sib txawv reactive ua ntej tshaj tawm nws. Ntxiv '~foo = …' nyob rau sab saum toj ntawm lub enclosing '@screen'.
architexDocs.errIndent: 'kev npaj txhij txog' - cov menyuam yaus yuav tsum yog ib theem tob dua li lawv niam lawv txiv. Architex siv raws nraim ob qhov chaw ib theem; tabs raug tsis lees paub kom tsis txhob pom cov kab-dawb dawb.
architexDocs.errModifier: 'unknown modifier' — koj sau ':: duab ntxoov ntxoo' tab sis lub sijhawm khiav tsis txhawb nws. Txheeb xyuas cov npe hloov kho saum toj no; Architex nruj me ntsis txog cov npe tsis paub los tiv thaiv kev sib raug zoo tom ntej.
architexDocs.errType: 'type mismatch' — e.g. koj dhau ib txoj hlua uas xav tau tus lej. Tshaj tawm qhov sib txawv reactive ('~ suav: tus lej') thiab tus parser yuav qhia koj qhov twg tus nqi phem tuaj.
architexDocs.errDebug: Txhawm rau debug ntawm lub sijhawm ua haujlwm, qhwv cov lus tsis txaus ntseeg hauv 'debug(...)' - lub sijhawm khiav txhua qhov kev ntsuam xyuas rau lub console yam tsis cuam tshuam tus nqi.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Web - ua rau hauv vanilla DOM nrog CSS hloov pauv rau lub ntsiab lus tokens. No React/Vue/Svelte dependency.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS - tib '.arx' yog parsed thiab rendered rau hauv SwiftUI views ntawm Vortex iOS host. Txhua tus hloov kho maps rau SwiftUI style.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android - tus tswv tsev ua rau hauv Jetpack Compose. Gesture modifiers (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) txhais ua Compose equivalents.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Version txoj cai - Architex lav rov qab sib raug zoo rau '.arx' cov ntaub ntawv hla cov me me. A '.arx' cov ntaub ntawv sau tawm tsam 0.1 tseem ua haujlwm ntawm 0.9.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Nyeem phau ntawv ua zaub mov rau cov qauv (cov npe tsis kawg, cov ntawv, kev them nyiaj), cov cuab yeej qhia rau CLI thiab VS Code plugin, thiab daim ntawv qhia kev pab yog tias koj xav tau ntxiv cov khoom tsim. Tag nrho qhov chaw yog ntawm github.com/vortex/Architex.

architecture.title: Architecture txheej txheem cej luam
architecture.subtitle: Peb txheej txheem - tus neeg siv khoom, node, tus tswj hwm - thiab ib txoj cai uas khi lawv.
architecture.intro: Vortex yog ib tug neeg xa xov liaison. Hloov chaw ntawm ib qho rov qab-kawg uas muaj los ntawm ib lub tuam txhab, nws federates qhib mesh ntawm ywj siab ** nodes **, nrhiav thiab vouched rau los ntawm ib tug compact **controller ** uas luam tawm ib tug kos npe rau manifest ntawm cov cai nws tau attested. **Cov neeg siv khoom** tuav txhua tus yuam sij ntiag tug thiab muab UI. Cov seem ntawm tshooj no taug kev peb txheej txheem, lawv cov ciam teb, thiab cov ntaub ntawv uas ntws ntawm lawv.
architecture.h1p1: Centralized tub txib yog ib qho taw tes ntawm kev quab yuam. Kev txiav txim hauv tsev hais plaub, huab cua-tus muab kev lag luam tawm, lossis kev yuav khoom tsis txaus ntseeg txhua tus txhais tau tias "cov neeg siv poob kev nkag mus". Vortex sidesteps uas yog cia leej twg khiav ib lub node thiab cia cov neeg siv txav ntawm nodes yam tsis rov sau npe.
architecture.h1p2: Decentralization yuav tsum khaws cia tsis pub leej twg paub thiab kev ncaj ncees. Lub koom haum ntawm cov servers tsis ntseeg tau ua haujlwm tsuas yog tias cov servers tsis tuaj yeem nyeem cov ntawv dawb thiab tsis tuaj yeem sau cov lus. Vortex tswj ob qho tib si ntawm qhov kawg-rau-kawg encryption thiab Ed25519 kev lees paub ntawm txhua qhov kev sib txuas lus.
architecture.h1p3: Tus maub los yog ib qho centralised-ish daim, tab sis nws yog me me. Nws tsuas yog tshaj tawm 'INTEGRITY.sig.json' thiab cov npe ntawm cov ntsiab lus nkag nkag. architecture.h3p1: Ib lub node yog Python txheej txheem (`python -m app.main`, lossis cov bundled `run.py`) mloog ntawm 9000 los ntawm lub neej ntawd. Nws txuas ntxiv ciphertext, kiv cua tawm WebSocket cov xwm txheej, tuav TURN cov ntaub ntawv pov thawj, thiab cov koom haum sib koom ua ke nrog lwm cov nodes.
architecture.h3p2: Cov txheej node txhob txwm tshaj tawm nyias. Nws nthuav tawm txog 120 txoj hauv kev hla '/ api / * ' tsob ntoo ntxiv rau '/ ws' rau lub sijhawm tiag tiag kiv cua-tawm. Kev nqa hnyav (crypto, muaj, teem sijhawm) yog ua rau "app / kev ruaj ntseg /", "app/transport/", "app/peer/".
architecture.h3p3: Ib qho ntawm ib qho ntawm lub neej ntawd SQLite hom ua haujlwm ~ 50 cov neeg siv tib lub sijhawm yooj yim ntawm M1. Nrog Postgres thiab Redis enabled, tib txoj cai ntsuas kab rov tav - txhua lub node dhau los ua neeg tsis muaj tebchaws dhau los ntawm DB thiab kiv cua tawm.
architecture.h3l1: Cov ntsiab lus nkag: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/kev ncaj ncees” thiab “/kev noj qab haus huv” rau kev ua neej nyob.
architecture.h3l2: Kev vam meej: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptography (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, Pillow, Rust extension 'vortex_chat' rau kub-txoj kev crypto.

architecture.h4p1: Tus maub los yog cov txheej txheem Python cais (`vortex_controller`) nrog lub hom phiaj nqaim: tshaj tawm thiab txheeb xyuas `INTEGRITY.sig.json`, nthuav tawm URLs nkag, thiab taug qab kev noj qab haus huv ntawm tsoomfwv cov phooj ywg.

Yog tias ib qho hash tsis sib haum, tus maub los tsis kam pib. Qhov no txhais tau hais tias cov ntaub ntawv tampered on-disk tsis tuaj yeem ua haujlwm rau ' xwm txheej: "tsim tseeb"`.
architecture.h4p3: Cov neeg siv khoom ntaus '/v1 / kev ncaj ncees' ua ntej lawv ntseeg qhov node. Yog lawv pom 'status != "verified"` lawv tsis kam muab daim ntawv pov thawj, lub sijhawm. Qhov ntawd yog qhov kev ntseeg siab.
architecture.h4l1: Kos npe nrog 'keys/release.key' (Ed25519). Pej xeem ib nrab ci rau hauv cov neeg siv khoom tso tawm.

architecture.h4l4: Kev sib hloov: tus neeg teb xov tooj forking Vortex hloov 'release.key'. Cov neeg siv khoom tau teeb tsa nrog lawv cov pubkey ces tso siab rau qhov nkhaus ntawd.
architecture.h5p1: Taug kev los ntawm qhov tshwm sim thaum Alice xa "nyob zoo" rau Bob:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Tus neeg siv khoom saib chav tsev tus yuam sij hauv paus hauv nws lub khw hauv zos. Yog tias tsis tuaj, nws nqa lub hnab ntawv tshiab los ntawm `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` rau nws tus kheej pubkey. Thawj zaug DMs khiav ib puag ncig Diffie-Hellman ntawm prekeys.
architecture.h5p3: 2. Client thav ntawv lub payload li CBOR `{v:1, text:"hi", reply_to:null, send_at:...}`, generates random 96-ntsis nonce, seals nrog AES-256-GCM, thiab POSTs `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`nce: hepsx, hex}`.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node khaws cov kab thiab cov kiv cua tawm `{ hom: "m", chav:..., msg: {id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, send_at}}` rau txhua qhov txuas WebSocket subscribed rau hauv chav.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Bob tus neeg siv tau txais cov ncej, decrypts nrog tib lub hauv paus tseem ceeb, txheeb xyuas tus xa ntawv pseudo qhov sib tw xav tau kev ua tswv cuab, thiab muab cov npuas.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Bob tus neeg siv khoom tshaj tawm `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` nrog tus lej nyeem ntawv kawg. Qhov ntawd ua rau `{type:"r"}` tshaj tawm yog li Alice's npuas qhia tau tias zuam.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) yog nruj, binary, thiab ceev rau encode. Muab piv rau JSON nws txiav qhov loj me me los ntawm ~ 30% ntawm kev sib tham ciphertext thiab tshem tawm qhov tsis meej pem.
architecture.h6p2: Piv rau Protobuf nws tsis xav tau lub tshuab hluav taws xob schema thiab tsis khov cov lej. Qhov ntawd tseem ceeb vim Vortex hloov zuj zus - peb tau ntxiv 'xov_id', 'reply_to', 'reactions_count', 'zoo' tshaj tawm yam tsis tau rhuav tshem cov neeg siv khoom qub.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR kuj yog dab tsi Signal, Matrix, thiab NIP-29 siv rau qhov laj thawj zoo sib xws. Kev sib piv lawv cov kev xaiv txhais tau tias peb cov txheej txheem yooj yim dua rau kev tshuaj xyuas los ntawm cov kws tshawb fawb txog kev nyab xeeb uas twb paub txog qhov encoding.
architecture.h7p1: Txhua tus ncej yog 'v:<int>`. Qhov tam sim no version yog 1. Ib tug ncej nrog ib tug tsis paub version yog poob; cov neeg tau txais kev ceeb toom thiab txuas ntxiv nrog rau cov ncej tom ntej.
architecture.h7p2: Backwards compatibility yog lav rau txhua tus ncej uas tseem nqa 'v: 1'. Kev sib raug zoo rau pem hauv ntej yog qhov zoo tshaj plaws-kev siv zog: cov teb tshiab tau ntxiv thaum kawg ntawm cov lus hais, cov neeg siv khoom qub tsis quav ntsej lawv.
architecture.h7p3: Kev tawg nyuaj yog tshwj tseg rau kev ruaj ntseg-tseem ceeb hloov pauv (xws li swapping HKDF cov ntsiab lus cov hlua). Nyob rau hauv cov ntaub ntawv no lub version tsoo rau 2 thiab lub qhov rais tsiv teb tsaws tau luam tawm.
architecture.h1_a: Lub Vortex network faib ua peb txheej txheem. Txhua tus khiav ntawm nws tus kheej, tham nrog lwm tus los ntawm cov txheej txheem xaim tau zoo, thiab tuaj yeem hloov nws tus kheej. Tsis muaj monolith - txhua qhov tshwj xeeb ntsaws rau hauv ib qho ntawm peb lub luag haujlwm.
architecture.h1_b: Tus neeg siv khoom tuav cov yuam sij thiab muab UI. Ib qhov txuas txuas ntxiv ciphertext, kiv cua tawm cov xwm txheej dhau WebSocket, thiab cov brokers WebRTC signaling. Tus maub los luam tawm cov ntawv kos npe thiab nkag URLs. Lawv sib txuas lus tshaj HTTPS + WebSocket siv CBOR-encoded payloads hauv AES-GCM hnab ntawv.
architecture.h1_c: Kev sib cais tau qhia nyob rau hauv v0.0.3 tom qab lub monolith version thaum ntxov tau khiav mus rau ob qhov teeb meem: kev tso tawm pov thawj tau khi rau ntawm qhov chaw khiav (yog li qhov cuam tshuam tuaj yeem dag txog nws tus kheej txoj cai), thiab tsoomfwv tsis tuaj yeem vim lub xeev thiab kev ntseeg siab nyob hauv tib lub rooj. Kev sib cais ua pov thawj tawm mus rau hauv nws tus kheej cov txheej txheem tau muab txhua tus neeg teb xov tooj ib tus pubkey rau tus pin thiab cia peb ntsuas lub koom haum rau arbitrary N.

tus neeg siv khoom --HTTPS/WSS--> node

architecture.h2_a: Cov node/controller cais cais cov khoom siv kev ruaj ntseg-rhiab tshaj plaws (kos npe tshwm sim) los ntawm qhov chaw tawm tsam loj tshaj plaws (API server).
architecture.h2_b: Controller khaws cov SQLite me me DB: pubkeys ntseeg siab, iav URLs, thiab cov qhab nia noj qab haus huv. Nws tsis kam pib yog tias INTEGRITY.sig.json tsis phim cov ntoo ntawm-disk - cov ntaub ntawv tampered tsis tuaj yeem ua haujlwm rau 'txhais tau tias:" txheeb xyuas"`. Cov node khiav ntawm nws tus kheej Postgres / SQLite thiab yeej tsis tuav tus yuam sij tso tawm.
architecture.h2_c: Cov qauv los ntawm Chrome lub hauv paus-khoom cais (cov ntawv pov thawj nyob ntawm qhov browser qhov tso tawm khiav, tsis yog lub hauv paus hauv paus) thiab Debian's Release.gpg (cov ntawv kos npe, pob ntawv tsis tau kos npe). Txais vim tias ob qho tib si tsim muaj sia nyob ntau xyoo ntawm kev tshuaj xyuas yeeb ncuab.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 ntawm txhua qhov hop, kawg-rau-kawg encrypted payloads sab hauv. TLS tuav thauj; AES-GCM tuav cov ntsiab lus.
architecture.h3_b: Nruab nrab ntawm tus neeg siv khoom thiab cov node: HTTPS (`/api/*`) thiab WSS (`/ws`). Nruab nrab ntawm cov nodes: HTTPS (`/federation/*`). Ntawm node thiab maub los: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Txhua tus siv TLS 1.3 nrog Chrome 120 ntiv tes tiv thaiv DPI.
architecture.h3_c: Thaum ntxov Vortex siv raw TCP nrog lub suab nrov-txoj kev sib tuav tes. Hloov mus rau TLS 1.3 nyob rau hauv v0.0.4 tom qab paub tias kev cai raws tu qauv teeb liab "nyiam" rau cov neeg soj ntsuam passive. TLS 1.3 yog qhov tho txawv, ubiquitous, thiab ECH-npaj — peb yam uas peb xav tau.
architecture.h3_f:
thauj txheej: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + yeem ECH (RFC 9460)
Cov ntsiab lus txheej: AES-256-GCM kaw hauv CBOR
architecture.h4_a: Ib qho lus tawm mus dhau plaub kauj ruam: ncej → encrypt → ncej → kiv cua tawm.
architecture.h4_b: Client suav cov yuam sij chav (X25519 + HKDF), thav ntawv cov lus li CBOR, ntsaws ruaj ruaj nrog AES-256-GCM siv random 96-ntsis nonce, POSTs rau `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Node khaws cov kab ntawv ciphertext thiab cov kiv cua tawm mus rau txhua qhov txuas WebSocket tau sau npe rau hauv chav. Tus neeg txais kev pab cuam decrypts nrog tib tus yuam sij. Round-trip latency nyob rau hauv 50 ms ntawm lub zos LAN, ~ 120 ms raug WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Cov kav dej plaub-kauj ruam yog tib lub teeb liab siv rau xyoo 2014; Peb hloov tsuas yog kev thauj mus los (WebSocket es tsis txhob Signal's TCP) thiab qhov encoding (CBOR tsis yog protobuf). Sib piv tus qauv tsim pov thawj yeej tsim ib qho tshiab.
architecture.h5_a: Peb tau xaiv CBOR tshaj JSON thiab Protobuf tom qab muab piv rau qhov loj me, kev hloov pauv, thiab kev debug ergonomics ntawm cov haujlwm sib tham tiag tiag.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR tsim ~ 30% me me payloads dua JSON ntawm unicode-hnyav cov lus, tsis muaj qhov tsis meej pem, thiab txhawb cov teb ntxiv yam tsis muaj schema generators. Proto yuav xav tau cov ntaub ntawv .proto ib qho kev tso tawm thiab yuav khov cov lej.
architecture.h5_c: Cov teeb liab hloov ntawm protobuf mus rau CBOR-zoo li framing hauv 2017 rau tib lub laj thawj. Matrix siv CBOR hauv nws lub xeev-kev daws teeb meem txheej. CBOR yog tus qauv IETF (RFC 8949) thiab txhua yam lus peb lub hom phiaj muaj lub tsev qiv ntawv loj.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR loj: ~0.7 × JSON ntawm utf-8

Ntxiv ib daim teb = append tom kawg. Cov neeg laus tsis quav ntsej.
architecture.h6_a: Vim li cas CBOR — ib feem ntawm tshooj architecture. Qhov no yog ib qho ntawm cov txheej txheem tseem ceeb hais txog thoob plaws hauv Vortex siv. Nyeem tshooj nyob ib puag ncig rau cov ntsiab lus dav dav; ntu no zooms rau ntawm tus cwj pwm tshwj xeeb.
architecture.h6_b: Kev piav qhia ntawm kev siv rau "Vim li cas CBOR". Cov txheej txheem yog siv nyob rau hauv cov coj module nyob rau hauv 'app/', 'ios/Modules/Sources/', los yog 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Lub module README hu tawm cov ntaub ntawv qhia tseeb.

Version keeb kwm nyob rau hauv 'CHANGELOG.md' cov ntaub ntawv thaum txhua daim tsaws thiab dab tsi txhawb nws.
architecture.h7_a: Protocol versioning - ib feem ntawm tshooj architecture. Qhov no yog ib qho ntawm cov txheej txheem tseem ceeb hais txog thoob plaws hauv Vortex siv. Nyeem tshooj nyob ib puag ncig rau cov ntsiab lus dav dav; ntu no zooms rau ntawm tus cwj pwm tshwj xeeb.

crypto.title: Cryptographic primitives
crypto.subtitle: Txhua algorithm nyob rau hauv pawg, nws lub hom phiaj, nws tsis, nws RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex tsuas yog siv cov kev tshuaj xyuas qub qub xwb. Tsis muaj kev cai thaiv ciphers, tsis muaj KDFs hauv tsev, tsis muaj cov phiaj xwm kos npe tshiab. Tshooj lus no sau tseg txhua qhov tseem ceeb uas peb siv, qhov tsis muaj tseeb, thiab qhov laj thawj tom qab txhua qhov kev xaiv.
crypto.h1: X25519 kev cog lus tseem ceeb
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) hauv nws daim ntawv Montgomery, siv rau Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman. 32-byte tus yuam sij ntiag tug, 32-byte pej xeem cov yuam sij, 32-byte qhia tawm cov ntaub ntawv zais cia.
crypto.h1p2: Siv rau: cov cuab yeej zoo li qub, cov yuam sij ephemeral sib tham, kaw lub hnab ntawv, lub hnab ntawv kaw lus, lub hnab ntawv hauv tebchaws.
crypto.h1p3: Kev siv iOS no: 'Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey' los ntawm CryptoKit. Android: `x25519-dalek` ntawm JNI. Node: 'cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519' dhau OpenSSL.
crypto.h1p4: Tag nrho peb interop ntsis-rau-ntsis. Round-trip sim tawm tsam RFC 7748 Alice/Bob test vectors ntawm txhua qhov tsim.
crypto.h1p5: Kev ua tau zoo: ~ 100 µs rau Diffie-Hellman ntawm 2020 iPhone, ~ 30 µs ntawm 2020 Mac. Ib puag ncig ntawm chav-qhov tseem ceeb wrapping rau ib pawg 200-tus tswv cuab yuav siv li 10 ms phab ntsa- moos.
crypto.h1p6: Tsis tu ncua-lub sij hawm: yog, ob qho tib si nyob rau hauv lub nkhaus arithmetic thiab raw-byte decoding txoj kev.
crypto.h1p7: Side-channel posture: Montgomery ntaiv tiv thaiv cov chav kawm ntawm lub sij hawm tawm tsam uas ntaus Weierstrass nkhaus; OpenSSL thiab Swift CryptoKit ob leeg siv nws.
crypto.h1p8: Key serialization: 32-byte me-endian. Cov yuam sij pej xeem raug clamped ntawm kev ntshuam yog li cov khoom siv tsis raug cai tsis ua rau qis-kev txiav txim-cov ntsiab lus xau.
crypto.h1l1: Vim li cas X25519 thiab tsis P-256: sai dua, me dua, tsis muaj NIST-kov kev txhawj xeeb.
crypto.h1l2: Yog vim li cas 32-byte tso zis thiab tsis 64: ntais ntawv HKDF-SHA256 input ntev raws nraim.
crypto.h1l3: Vim li cas Montgomery thiab tsis yog Edwards: peb tsuas yog xav tau DH, tsis kos npe, ntawm cov khoom tseem ceeb no. Edwards yuav xav tau ib kauj ruam hloov dua siab tshiab txhua lub sijhawm.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) dhau edwards25519. 32-byte public key, 64-byte kos npe.
crypto.h2p2: Siv rau: node attestations ntawm tsoom fwv teb chaws cov lus, tso tawm-kos npe tseem ceeb tshaj qhov kev ncaj ncees manifest, bot deploy kos npe, ntaus ntawv mus sij hawm ntev tus kheej rau Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Kev txiav txim siab: tus RFC 8032 variant peb siv ua tib yam kos npe ob zaug rau tib cov lus + tus yuam sij. Apple's CryptoKit ntawm iOS 17+ siv RFC 8032bis randomized variant - ob qho tib si siv tau thiab ob qho tib si txheeb xyuas nrog txhua tus neeg ua pov thawj.
crypto.h2p4: Tus nqi pov thawj: ~ 200 µs ntawm ib qho niaj hnub CPU. Batch verify (`batch_verify([msg,sig,pk]*N)`) yog ~ 10 × sai dua rau ib qho kos npe.
crypto.h2p5: Kos npe hom: `R || S`, 32 bytes txhua, me ntsis-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Public key sawv cev: 32-byte compressed point. Ib txwm siv tau - tsis muaj "point ntawm infinity" rooj plaub.
crypto.h2l2: Private key sawv cev: 32-byte noob. Cov scalar nthuav dav yog muab los ntawm ya ntawm SHA-512.
crypto.h2l3: Vim li cas ho tsis ECDSA: ECDSA xav tau cov khoom zoo RNG rau txhua qhov kos npe; qhov tsis ncaj ncees RNG xau tus yuam sij ntiag tug. Ed25519 yog kev txiav txim siab, tsis muaj RNG xav tau ntawm lub sijhawm kos npe.
crypto.h3: Cov ntaub ntawv pov thawj encryption tau txais kev lees paub los ntawm cov neeg siv khoom
crypto.h3p1: AES hauv Galois / Counter Mode (NIST SP 800-38D). 256-ntsis yuam sij, 96-ntsis nonces, 128-ntsis authentication tags.
crypto.h3p2: Siv rau: lub hnab ntawv ciphertext, cov ntaub ntawv chunk hnab ntawv, encrypted backup payloads, kaw laub payloads.
crypto.h3p3: Tsis siv neeg: txhua cov lus tsim tawm tshiab 96-ntsis random nonce. Cov node taug qab qhov kawg 10^6 nonces ib chav thiab tee duplicates defensively - tus neeg siv yuav tsum tsis txhob tsim duplicates nyob rau hauv thawj qhov chaw, tab sis xav tias-tsis muaj dab tsi yog pheej yig.
crypto.h3p4: Vim li cas 96-ntsis nonces thiab tsis yog 128-ntsis: 96-ntsis yog GCM-tus qauv "deterministic" tsis ntev, thiab nws muab rau peb 2 ^ 32 random nonces ua ntej hnub yug kev sib tsoo ua ib qho kev txhawj xeeb. Ib chav tseem ceeb yog tig ntev ua ntej ntawd, yog li nws muaj kev nyab xeeb.

cryptoWire.h2p3: Tag nrho cov ntaub ntawv kev ncaj ncees: tus neeg siv khoom suav BLAKE3 tshaj plaintext thiab xa raws li 'plain_blake3' rau tus neeg tau txais los ntawm cov lus hauv chav. Tus neeg txais yuav rov xam tom qab rub tawm thiab txheeb xyuas.
cryptoWire.h3: Lub hnab ntawv kaw ntom nti
cryptoWire.h3p1: Client uploads `p256dh_pub` (32-byte X25519) rau ntawm qhov.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Thaum lub laub dhau lawm, node tsim ib qho ephemeral X25519 tus yuam sij, puas DH nrog 'p256dh_pub`, muab tus yuam sij AES-GCM ntawm HKDF.
cryptoWire.h3p3: foob ​​blob: `{endpoint, p256dh: client's pub, auth: 16 bytes, data: ciphertext||tag}`. APNs/FCM pom tsuas yog 'cov ntaub ntawv'.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Cov neeg siv khoom decrypts ntawm kev tau txais siv nws tus yuam sij ntiag tug thiab 'p256dh' (uas yog qhov tseeb ntawm node's ephemeral pub hauv lub hnab ntawv).
cryptoWire.h4p1: Password derives backup key ntawm Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, ntsev=<random 16B>, hashLen=32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{ ntsev, tsis yog, ciphertext}`. Ciphertext yog CBOR ntawm `{v:1, chav:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], profile:{...}, contacts:[...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Khaws cia hauv zos (iCloud / Google Drive) lossis ntawm ib qho ntawm tus neeg siv chav tsev ntiag tug.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Hla-node lus: `{source_node: <pubkey>, target_user: <id>, inner: {... tib yam li chav hnab ntawv ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` npog cov CBOR-serialised `{source_node, target_user, inner}`. Lub hom phiaj txheeb xyuas tawm tsam 'source_node' pubkey los ntawm 'trusted_nodes'.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Ib chav lus ntawm cov xov hlau yog ib qho CBOR dict nrog ib tug encrypted payload, ib tug nonce, ib tug sender pseudonym, thiab ib tug timestamp. Lub hnab ntawv zoo ib yam txawm tias nws caij HTTPS (POST) lossis WebSocket (ntev hom `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Client serialises cov lus lub cev `{v:1, ntawv nyeem, teb_to, send_at}` as CBOR → `pt`. Tsim ib qho random 12-byte nonce. Computes `aad = hex(room_id)`. Hu rau `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt(room_key, nonce, pt, aad)`. Muab qhwv rau hauv `{v:1, ciphertext: hex(ct), nonce: hex(nonce), sender_pseudo: hex(pseudo), send_at: unix_ms}` thiab xa. Tus neeg txais ntawv lees paub GCM tag thaum lub sijhawm decrypt, tom qab ntawd CBOR-parses cov ntawv dawb.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Cov hlau zoo li version-tagged txij li v0.0.4 tom qab rho tawm v0.0.3 tso tawm uas tsis muaj 'v' teb - peb yuav tsum tau tsoo tag nrho cov hom ntawv thaum peb ntxiv 'xov_id' vim tias cov neeg siv khoom qub tsoo ntawm tus yuam sij tsis paub. Cov lus kawm tau kawm: txhua lub neej yav tom ntej hlau zoo yog 'v:N' hauv nws thawj daim teb kom ua rau kev sib raug zoo yog qhov tseeb.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Cov ntaub ntawv raug muab faib ua ntu ntu ntu, txhua tus nrog nws tus kheej qhov tseem ceeb tau los ntawm cov ntaub ntawv hauv paus thiab cov chunk offset. Per-chunk encryption cia tus xa tuaj nres / rov pib dua ntawm txhua qhov ciam teb.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Cov ntaub ntawv hauv paus tseem ceeb yog random 32 bytes. Per-chunk key yog `HKDF(root, info="file:chunk:" + str(offset), len=32)`. Txhua chunk yog AES-GCM encrypted nrog nws tus kheej qhov tseem ceeb, random 96-ntsis nonce, thiab 'aad = file_id ∥ offset`. Chunks default rau 512 KiB; 4 MiB kab. Tag nrho cov ntaub ntawv BLAKE3 raug xa mus ua 'plain_blake3' hauv cov lus hauv chav uas hais txog cov ntaub ntawv kom cov neeg txais tuaj yeem txheeb xyuas tom qab decryption.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chunked E2E encryption nrog cov yuam sij ib chunk tau pioneered los ntawm Mega.nz nyob rau hauv 2013 thiab refined los ntawm Signal cov ntaub ntawv loj txhawb nyob rau hauv 2019. Vortex lub 512 KiB default yog qhov luaj li cas uas TCP ntws tswj tuav cov kav dej ntev ntev. Peb kuaj 256/512/1024/4096 KiB thiab 512 yog qhov chaw qab zib hauv peb qhov ntsuas.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Lub hnab ntawv kaw ntom nti zais cov ntawv ceeb toom them nyiaj los ntawm Apple / Google / Mozilla los ntawm kev encrypting nrog cov cuab yeej tshwj xeeb X25519 tus yuam sij.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Client sau npe 'p256dh_pub' thiab 'auth' ntawm node. Thaum lub laub dhau lawm, cov node khiav ephemeral-ECDH nrog p256dh_pub, muab qhov tseem ceeb + nonce ntawm HKDF nrog auth zais cia li ntsev. Encrypts `{title, body, room_id, message_id}` nrog AES-GCM. Xa cov ntaub ntawv raws li opaque 'cov ntaub ntawv' teb mus rau tus muab kev pabcuam thawb. Cov cuab yeej txuas ntxiv rov ua dua, decrypts, renders.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Muab kaw yog Web Push Message Encryption spec (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple tau txais nws hauv iOS 16's Notification Service Extensions. Ua ntej kaw lub laub tau txais kev txhawb nqa dav dav, Teeb liab thiab WhatsApp xa ntsiag to "ib yam dab tsi tuaj txog" pings yam tsis muaj cov ntsiab lus thiab muaj lub app nqa cov lus ntawm kev sawv - uas qeeb. Kev sib foob muab rau peb kawg-rau-kawg kev ceev ntiag tug ntxiv rau qhov ua tiav sai.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Encrypted backup blob cia tus neeg siv rov qab cov yuam sij hauv chav + profile + 90 hnub kawg ntawm lub cuab yeej tshiab los ntawm tus password ib leeg.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Tus yuam sij thaub qab muab los ntawm tus password ntawm Argon2id nrog random 16-byte ntsev. Payload yog CBOR: `{v:1, chav: [{id, key, msg_ref_ids}], profile, contacts}`. Encrypted nrog AES-GCM hauv qab tus yuam sij muab tau. Khaws cia hauv zos (iCloud / Google Drive) lossis ua cov ntaub ntawv hauv tus neeg siv chav huab huab. Restore: nkag mus rau lo lus zais → Argon2id → decrypt → reimport cov yuam sij thiab cov ntaub ntawv siv.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Cov hom ntawv yog qauv ntawm 1Password's OPVault (2013) thiab Bitwarden's encrypted export (2017). Ob leeg siv KDF-thov-AEAD nrog ntsev-bundled metadata. Vortex ntxiv 90-hnub trimming vim tias cov ntaub ntawv keeb kwm tag nrho yog 100 MB+ hauv kev sim; Feem coob ntawm kev rov qab tsuas yog xav tau cov lus tsis ntev los no, thiab cov ntsiab lus qub tseem tuaj yeem ncav cuag ntawm server ciphertext thaum tus neeg siv muaj kev sib txuas.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Hla-node federation xov xwm qhwv lub hnab ntawv uas twb tau encrypted nyob rau hauv ib lub hnab ntawv kos npe sab nrauv authenticating lub hauv paus ntawm.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A serialises `{source_node, target_user, inner_ct, inner_nonce, send_at}` as CBOR. Kos npe nrog nws Ed25519 ntiag tug tso qhov tseem ceeb → 'sig'. POSTs `{envelope, sig}` rau node B's `/federation/deliver`. B txheeb xyuas 'sig' tawm tsam pubkey rau 'source_node' hauv 'federations', tshawb xyuas lub sij hawm nyob rau hauv 5-feeb skew qhov rais, ces sau lub puab ciphertext rau nws tus kheej 'cov lus' rooj rau cov neeg siv lub hom phiaj.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Cov hnab ntawv kos npe sab nraud tau txais qiv los ntawm Matrix lub koom haum spec (2015) thiab ActivityPub's HTTP Kos npe (2018). Lub 5-feeb qhov rais sib tw SMTP's RFC 5321 kev pom zoo thiab tiv thaiv kev tawm tsam rov qab qhov twg tus neeg tawm tsam ntes ib lub koomhaum POST thiab rov ua nws ntau teev tom qab. Vortex xaiv Ed25519 dhau RSA-PSS vim Ed25519 kos npe yog 64 bytes vs RSA-PSS-2048's 256 bytes - teeb meem thaum lub koomhaum sib tham.
cryptoWire.h2_f:
file_root = rand(32)
chunk_key(o) = HKDF(file_root, "file:chunk:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct(o) = AES-GCM(chunk_key(o), rand(12), plaintext, aad=file_id ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3(plaintext_bytes_of_full_file) // xa as plain_blake3
cryptoWire.h3_f:
ephemeral = (priv, pub);  ikm = ECDH(ephemeral.priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(auth, ikm)
key = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Cov ntsiab lus-Encoding: aes128gcm\0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM(key, nonce, CBOR{title, body, room_id, message_id})
xaim = ntsev(16) ∥ rs(4) ∥ idlen(1) ∥ ephemeral.pub(32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
ntsev = rand(16)
key = Argon2id(password, ntsev, m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, len=32)
nonce = rand(12)
ct = AES-GCM(key, nonce, CBOR{chav, profile, contacts}, aad="vortex-backup-v1")
file = {v:1, ntsev, nonce, ct}

auth.title: Kev lees paub tseeb
auth.subtitle: Register, login, refresh, revoke. JWT + X25519 + yeem passkey / noob / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex teeb meem JWTs luv luv (15 feeb nkag, 30 hnub rov ua dua) nrog tus neeg siv X25519 pej xeem tus yuam sij khi rau hauv. Txhua qhov kev txheeb xyuas qhov kawg rhiab JWT + txheeb xyuas tus yuam sij tsis tau muab tshem tawm. Tshooj lus no suav nrog txhua qhov ntws mus rau qhov kawg.
auth.h1p1: Tus neeg siv khoom pib los ntawm kev tsim ib qho tshiab 32-byte X25519 tus yuam sij ntiag tug nrog OS RNG. Nws muab tau tus yuam sij pej xeem, encodes li 64 hex chars.
auth.h1p2: Cov neeg siv khoom tshaj tawm `POST /api/authentication/register` nrog `{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, xov tooj, email, avatar_emoji, kyber_public_key?}`.
auth.h1p3: Node validates: username matches `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (tso qis kom tsis txhob homograph squats); lo lus zais dhau zxcvbn-style lub zog (min tau qhab nia 2); xov tooj sib tw E.164 yog muab; email ntais ntawv RFC 5322 yooj yim regex yog muab.
auth.h1p4: Node checks 'x25519_public_key' uniqueness - txhua tus pubkey tuaj yeem sau npe raws nraim ib tus account. Qhov no txwv tsis pub sau npe ntau tawm tsam uas rov siv tib lub pubkey.
auth.h1p5: Node khiav Argon2id ntawm tus password (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) thiab khw muag khoom 'argon2:$...$' hauv 'users.password_hash'.
auth.h1p6: Node mints ob JWTs: nkag mus (15 feeb, `jti:<device_id>`) thiab refresh (30 d). Claims: `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access|refresh, exp: ...}`. Kos npe HS256 tshaj 64-byte server zais cia los ntawm `.env`.
auth.h1p7: Node tsim ib kab `user_devices`: `{user_id, device_id, user_agent, created_at}`. Txhua refresh yog khi rau nws device_id; tshem tawm cov cuab yeej tua tsuas yog cov kwj dej xwb.
auth.h1p8: Teb: `{ok, user_id, username, access_token, refresh_token, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key, display_name, avatar_url, xov tooj, email}`.
auth.h1p9: Client stores tokens in Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies (web).
auth.h1l1: Tus nqi txwv: 5 sau npe rau 60 vib nas this ib IP. TESTING=true disables qhov no.
auth.h1l2: Caw hom: yog 'REGISTRATION_MODE=invite', lub cev yuav tsum suav nrog qhov siv tau 'invite_code'. Cov lej yog tsim los ntawm admin API.
auth.h1l3: Kaw hom: `REGISTRATION_MODE=kaw`. Tsuas yog cov noob admin tuaj yeem sau npe. Cov neeg siv tom qab tuaj txog ntawm kev caw txuas mus rau hauv cov chav tshwj xeeb.
auth.h2p2: Node queries 'cov neeg siv' los ntawm cov npe siv qis. Yog tias tsis pom, nws tseem khiav lub dummy Argon2 txheeb xyuas tawm tsam qhov hash tas li kom sib npaug sijhawm (~ 0.5 s ob txoj kev).
auth.h2p3: Yog tias Argon2 txheeb xyuas ua tiav thiab tus account tsis raug cuam tshuam, node rov qab tib lub hnab ntawv raws li kev sau npe. Ib kab tshiab 'user_devices' tau tsim; cov kab uas twb muaj lawm raug tso tseg ib leeg kom tus neeg siv tuaj yeem kos npe rau ntawm ntau yam khoom siv.
auth.h2p4: Yog tias tsis lees paub, node rov qab 401 nrog `{ yuam kev: "cov ntaub ntawv pov thawj tsis raug"}`. Tsis muaj qhov sib txawv ntawm "tus neeg siv lub npe tsis raug" thiab "tus password tsis raug" hauv cov lus teb.
auth.h2l1: Tus nqi txwv: 10 ua tsis tau tejyam sim ib 60 vib nas this ib IP. Tshaj rov qab 429 nrog 'Retry-After' header.
auth.h2l2: Tus account lockout: 20 ua tsis tau tejyam sim nyob rau hauv 24 h chij tus account rau admin tshuaj xyuas. Legit cov neeg siv tsuas yog lo lus zais-rov pib dua lawv txoj hauv kev.
auth.h2l3: Session tracking: `/api/authentication/devices` teev tag nrho cov kev ua haujlwm nquag; tus neeg siv tuaj yeem tshem tawm ib qho twg.
auth.h3p1: Thaum tus token nkag mus tau ze ze (cov neeg siv khoom 'exp' hauv zos) lossis thaum qhov kev thov rov qab 401 nrog 'token tas sij hawm', tus neeg siv tau tshaj tawm `POST /api/authentication/refresh` nrog `{refresh_token}`.
auth.h3p2: Node decodes lub refresh, xyuas cov 'jti' tseem nyob rau hauv 'user_devices' (tsis tau tshem tawm), kos 'exp', thiab mints ib tug tshiab nkag token.
auth.h3p3: Refresh rotation yog off los ntawm lub neej ntawd. Pab kom nrog 'ROTATE_REFRESH=true' los tawm qhov tshiab tshiab ib yam nkaus.
auth.h3p4: Yog tias qhov hloov tshiab tas sij hawm, tshem tawm, lossis forged, node rov qab 401. Cov neeg siv khoom tawm hauv zos thiab hais kom rov nkag mus.
auth.h4p1: Cov neeg siv lub vev xaib tuaj yeem sau npe rau lub platform authenticator (Kov ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric). Server khaws `{credential_id, public_key, counter}`.
auth.h4p2: ID nkag mus: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → server rov kev sib tw; tus neeg siv khoom kos npe nrog tus password ntiag tug (tseem nyob hauv Secure Enclave / TPM); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → server txheeb xyuas thiab teeb meem JWT.
auth.h4p3: Counter monotonicity check: txhua qhov kev pov thawj yuav tsum nce lub txee. Yog tias nws tsis yog, tus passkey raug kho raws li cloned thiab tsis lees paub.
auth.h5p1: Raws li txoj kev puas tsuaj rov qab los, tus neeg siv tuaj yeem xa tawm 24-lo lus BIP-39 noob. Importing nws ntawm ib lub cuab yeej reconstructs X25519 tus kheej (noob → HKDF → static key) thiab ua pov thawj muaj los ntawm kev sib tw kos npe.
auth.h5p2: Noob yeej tsis tawm ntawm lub cuab yeej. Cov node tsuas pom qhov muab tau los ntawm X25519 pej xeem tus yuam sij thiab kos npe rau kev sib tw server.
auth.h5p3: Entropy: 256 khoom (32 bytes). BIP-39 checksum yog tus qauv, yog li typos raug ntes ua ntej mus txog lub server.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) nrog 30-s cov kauj ruam thiab 6-tus lej lej. Kev xaiv rau ib tus neeg siv.
auth.h6p2: Kev tso npe nkag: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` rov qab zais zais + otpauth URI + QR. Cov neeg siv scans nrog Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password. Tus neeg siv xa rov qab tus qauv 6 tus lej lej los ua pov thawj lub app ua haujlwm.
auth.h6p3: Nkag mus nrog 2FA: tom qab lo lus zais dhau, node rov qab "{needs_2fa: tseeb}". Client prompts rau tus lej thiab tshaj tawm rau '/api/authentication/login/2fa'.
auth.h6p4: Tus nqi txwv: 5 TOTP sim ib 5 feeb rau ib tus neeg siv. Kev tshaj tawm ua rau 60-thib ob cooldown thiab email ceeb toom.
auth.h6p5: Cov lej thaub qab: 12 × 10-tus lej cov lej tso tawm ib zaug thaum tso npe. Txhua tus lej tuaj yeem siv raws nraim ib zaug.
auth.h7: QR tus ID nkag mus (sib npaug-account pairing)
auth.h7p1: Lub xov tooj nkag mus tuaj yeem tso rau hauv lub ntsiav tshuaj tshiab nrog QR code. Ntaus A posts `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` → neeg rau zaub mov xa rov qab rau qhov nonce thiab TTL.
auth.h7p2: Ntaus A qhia txog QR uas muaj 'nonce + user_id + server_url'. Ntaus B scans thiab posts `POST /api/authentication/qr/verify` nrog rau qhov nonce.
auth.h7p3: Tus neeg rau zaub mov paub tseeb tias tsis yog tseem nyob (TTL 60 s, txhaj tshuaj ib zaug), khi ntaus ntawv B tus tshiab X25519 pubkey rau tus neeg siv A tus account (tshiab 'tus neeg siv khoom' kab), thiab rov qab JWT rau ntaus B.
auth.h7p4: Ntaus A tau txais WebSocket ceeb toom `{ hom: "n", qhov tshwm sim: "new_device"}` yog li tus neeg siv tuaj yeem lees paub / thim rov qab ntawm lub sijhawm.
auth.h8p1: Peb txhob txwm xa rov qab qhov yuam kev qub rau "tsis paub tus neeg siv lub npe" thiab "tus password tsis raug". Tus nqi sau npe txwv zais cov npe neeg siv twg muaj nyob.
auth.h8p2: Profile endpoints (`/api/users/{username}`) xav tau auth. Attacker tsis tuaj yeem suav cov npe siv yam tsis muaj token siv tau.
auth.h8p3: Tus nqi txwv ntawm '/api/authentication/login' ua rau brute quab yuam kom nkag mus.
auth.h1_a: Kev tso npe tsim ib tus neeg tshiab: X25519 keypair ntawm lub cuab yeej, Argon2id lo lus zais hash ntawm tus neeg rau zaub mov, JWT khub tawm ntawm kev ua tiav.
auth.h1_b: Kauj ruam 1: tus neeg siv khoom siv 'crypto.randomBytes(32)' rau X25519 tus yuam sij ntiag tug, muab tus yuam sij rau pej xeem (~ 100 µs hauv xov tooj). Kauj ruam 2: POST /api/authentication/register nrog `{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, xov tooj, email, avatar_emoji}`. Kauj ruam 3: node validates ntawm Pydantic (username regex, password ≥ 8 chars, xov tooj E.164, email RFC-5322-lite). Kauj ruam 4: node sau Argon2id (password) → `argon2:...`, khw hauv 'users.password_hash`. Kauj ruam 5: node teeb meem nkag JWT (15 feeb) + refresh JWT (30 hnub), txuas ntxiv mus rau 'tus neeg siv khoom' kab.
auth.h1_c: Qhov ntws yog qhov kev hloov pauv niaj hnub ntawm PHP's mysql_real_escape_string era. Txhua pawg auth niaj hnub - Auth0, Firebase, Supabase - ua qhov zoo li no. Qhov kev sib tw tshwj xeeb hauv Vortex yog xa X25519 pubkey hauv kev sau npe hu: nws txhais tau tias tus account raug khi rau lub sijhawm ntev E2E tus kheej los ntawm tus ncej, tsis ntxiv tom qab. Kev tshoov siab los ntawm Signal's 2013 raws tu qauv tsim.
auth.h2_a: Tus ID nkag mus txheeb xyuas tus password tiv thaiv qhov khaws cia Argon2 hash thiab teeb tsa ib qho tshiab JWT khub yog tias nws phim.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/authentication/login nrog `{username, password}`. Node queries 'cov neeg siv' los ntawm cov npe siv qis. Yog tias pom, txheeb xyuas Argon2id hauv lub sijhawm tas li tawm tsam 'users.password_hash'. Yog tias tsis pom, tseem khiav lub dummy Argon2 txheeb xyuas cov hlua tas li kom sib npaug sijhawm. Kev vam meej → tshiab JWT khub + tshiab 'tus neeg siv khoom' kab (ib qho ntawm cov khoom siv nkag). Ua tsis tiav → 401 nrog ib qho "cov ntaub ntawv pov thawj tsis raug" - tsis muaj qhov sib txawv ntawm tus neeg siv lub npe tsis zoo thiab tus password tsis zoo, kom tiv thaiv kev suav sau.
auth.h2_c: Kev txheeb xyuas tas li-lub sij hawm thiab dummy hashing rau cov neeg siv tsis muaj nyob yog tus qauv teeb liab tau txais hauv xyoo 2014 tom qab cov kws tshawb fawb tau pom lub sijhawm sau npe ntawm lawv qhov kawg nkag mus. Txij thaum ntawd los nws tau dav siv - django-axes, athelia, Keycloak txhua yam siv nws. Kev xyaum ntxiv ~ 0.5 s rau txhua qhov kev nkag mus tsis tau, uas yog qhov zoo; peb ntsuas-txheej nkag nkag ntawm 10/min/IP lawm.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id("__timing_equaliser__", ntsev = tsau, ...)

login(u,p):
  row = users.find(username=u.lower())
  yog kab tsis muaj:
      Argon2Verify(dummy_hash, p) // sib npaug sijhawm
      nce 401
  yog tsis Argon2Verify(row.password_hash, p):
      nce 401
  rov issue_jwt(row)
auth.h3_a: Access tokens tas sij hawm tom qab 15 feeb. Refresh pauv lub token nyob rau lub sijhawm ntev rau kev nkag mus rau token tshiab yam tsis tau nug tus neeg siv rau lawv tus password.
auth.h3_b: Client track 'exp' hauv zos. Thaum 'tam sim no + 30s> exp', lossis thaum qhov kev thov rov qab 401 nrog 'token_expired', tus neeg siv khoom POSTs lub token refresh rau '/api/authentication/refresh'. Node decodes, checks 'jti' yog nyob rau hauv 'user_devices' thiab tsis 'revoked_at', checks 'exp', thiab mints tus tshiab 15-feeb nkag token. Kev hloov pauv hloov tshiab yog xaiv los ntawm 'ROTATE_REFRESH = tseeb' - tawm los ntawm lub neej ntawd vim tias kev hloov pauv hloov tshiab tokens ntawm txhua qhov kev nkag mus rau refresh tsim kev sib tw thaum ob tus neeg siv khoom tshiab ib txhij.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) tau qhia txog kev nkag + kev cais tawm tshiab. Lub sijhawm 15 feeb nkag mus rau lub neej yog qhov nruab nrab ntawm kev lag luam - Google siv 1 teev, Auth0 defaults rau 24 teev, Okta rau 1 teev. Peb tau xaiv 15 feeb kom txo qis lub qhov rais thaum lub sij hawm tus neeg nyiag nkag token siv tau. 30-hnub hloov tshiab yog qhov uas feem ntau cov apps hauv xov tooj xav tau kom cov neeg siv nkag mus rau hauv ib hlis ntawm kev tsis ua haujlwm.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / passkey login siv lub platform authenticator (Kov ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) es tsis txhob lo lus zais.
auth.h4_b: Kev Sau Npe: server tshaj tawm kev sib tw; tus neeg siv khoom pov thawj tsim cov keypair tshiab hauv nws qhov chaw ruaj ntseg thiab xa rov qab rau pej xeem tus yuam sij + ntawv pov thawj. Server khaws `{credential_id, public_key, counter}`. ID nkag mus: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → neeg rau zaub mov rov qab kev sib tw; tus neeg siv khoom kos npe nrog tus neeg lees paub tus yuam sij ntiag tug (tseem nyob hauv Secure Enclave, tsis txhob tso lub nti); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → neeg rau zaub mov txheeb xyuas qhov kos npe tawm tsam tus yuam sij rau pej xeem. Lub txee monotonic kuaj pom cov ntawv pov thawj cloned.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn tau tsim los ntawm W3C hauv 2019 tom qab xyoo ua haujlwm los ntawm FIDO Alliance. Apple ntxiv platform-authenticator txhawb nqa hauv iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Password ua raws. Vortex tau txais WebAuthn hauv v0.0.8. Nws yog ib qho kev xaiv tab sis pom zoo - cov neeg siv passkey yeej tsis pom phishing-raws li tus account takeover vim hais tias tus yuam sij ntiag tug yeej tsis hla tus ciam teb ntaus ntawv.
auth.h5_a: Seed-phrase recovery reconstructs X25519 tus kheej ntawm lub cuab yeej tshiab los ntawm 24-lo lus BIP-39 mnemonic. Tsis txhob xav kom tus neeg rau zaub mov tuav cov khoom siv decryption.
auth.h5_b: Tus neeg siv sau cov mnemonic thaum thawj zaug tso tawm (yeem, ib zaug kom sai). Yuav kom rov qab tau: ntawm cov cuab yeej tshiab, cov neeg siv nkag mus rau mnemonic; tus neeg siv khoom khiav PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(mnemonic, "mnemonic", 2048 rounds) → 64 bytes ntawm cov noob. Cov noob thawj 32 bytes dhau los ua X25519 tus yuam sij ntiag tug; Public key yog muab los. Tus neeg rau zaub mov tsuas yog qhia rau pej xeem tus yuam sij tshiab; nws txheeb xyuas qhov muaj nrog Ed25519 kev sib tw- teb (kos npe tsis yog), tom qab ntawd teeb meem JWTs.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bitcoin Txhim Kho Kev Pom Zoo 39, 2013) yog txoj hauv kev los encode cryptographic secrets raws li cov npe cov lus nco. 2048-lo lus lus Askiv phau ntawv txhais lus nrog 4-byte checksum thaum kawg. Vortex siv 24 lo lus vim tias cov qauv kev lag luam rau cov hnab nyiaj ruaj ntseg (Trezor, Ledger) yog 24. 12 cov lus yuav txaus rau 128-ntsis kev ruaj ntseg tab sis tsis zoo txaus rau cov neeg siv feem ntau.
auth.h5_f:
lus = BIP39_Encode(entropy=256_bits + 8_bit_checksum)
noob = PBKDF2-SHA512(lus, "mnemonic", rounds=2048, len=64)
sk = seed[0:32] // X25519 private
pk = sk · G // X25519 public
auth.h6_a: Ob-factor authentication ntxiv ib lub sij hawm-raws li tus password (TOTP) kauj ruam tom qab kev txheeb xyuas tus password.
auth.h6_b: Kev sau npe: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → server tsim 160-ntsis random zais cia, rov qab los ua ib txoj hlua base32 + ib otpauth: // URI rau QR scanning. Cov neeg siv scans nrog Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password; xa rov qab tus qauv 6-tus lej los ua pov thawj kev teeb tsa ua haujlwm. Nkag mus: tom qab lo lus zais dhau, server rov qab `{needs_2fa: tseeb}` hloov JWTs. Client prompts rau 6-tus lej code thiab POSTs `/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Tus neeg rau zaub mov txheeb xyuas HOTP( zais cia, T = now_unix / 30) tawm tsam cov cai.
auth.h6_c: TOTP tau tsim raws li RFC 6238 hauv 2011 los ntawm Mark Pei. Ua ntej ntawd, RSA SecurID siv lub tswv yim algorithm; Tom qab ntawd, txhua txhua 2FA app tau teeb tsa ntawm TOTP. Vortex's 30-thib ob kauj ruam thiab 6 tus lej ntev yog RFC defaults. Cov lej thaub qab (12 × 10 tus lej, qhia ib zaug) yog qiv los ntawm GitHub tus tsim los ntawm 2012.
auth.h6_f:
zais cia = rand(20 bytes) // 160 khoom ib RFC 6238
TOTP(secret, t) = HOTP(secret, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP(k, c) = truncate( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 10⁶

Qhov rai: ± 1 kauj ruam zam rau lub moos skew
auth.h7_a: QR nkag mus ua khub ib lub cuab yeej tshiab rau hauv tus account uas twb muaj lawm yam tsis tau rov ntaus tus password. Lub xov tooj uas twb tau nkag mus hauv lub xov tooj tau kos npe rau qhov tsis yog tias lub cuab yeej tshiab siv los ua pov thawj.
auth.h7_b: Ntaus A posts `/api/authentication/qr/begin`. Server generates 128-ntsis nonce nrog TTL 60s, khi rau A's user_id, rov qab rau nws. Ib qho qhia txog qhov nonce encoded li QR (xws li 'nonce + user_id + server_url'). Ntaus B scans, posts `/api/authentication/qr/verify` nrog rau qhov nonce. Server: tsis siv tau thiab txhaj tshuaj ib zaug? Associate B's tshiab X25519 pubkey nrog user_id (tshiab 'user_devices' kab), mint JWTs rau B. Ntaus A tau txais WebSocket ceeb toom kom tus neeg siv tuaj yeem pom thiab xaiv tshem tawm.
auth.h7_c: QR-raws li kev ua khub yog thawj zaug nrov los ntawm WhatsApp Web hauv 2015. Telegram ua raws; Cov teeb liab tau theej nws rau lawv qhov kev txhawb nqa ntau lub cuab yeej hauv xyoo 2021. Vortex's twist: txhua qhov kev sib koom ua ke ntawm qhov chaw ntawm lub cuab yeej qub nrog lub pob "paub meej", yog li tus neeg tawm tsam uas rub QR ntawm lub screenshot tsis tuaj yeem ua tiav khub yam tsis muaj kev sib cuam tshuam ntawm cov khoom siv A.
auth.h8_a: Account enumeration resistance — ib feem ntawm auth tshooj. Qhov no yog ib qho ntawm cov txheej txheem tseem ceeb hais txog thoob plaws hauv Vortex siv. Nyeem tshooj nyob ib puag ncig rau cov ntsiab lus dav dav; ntu no zooms rau ntawm tus cwj pwm tshwj xeeb.
auth.h8_b: Cov txheej txheem ua tiav rau "Account enumeration resistance". Cov txheej txheem yog siv nyob rau hauv cov coj module nyob rau hauv 'app/', 'ios/Modules/Sources/', los yog 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Lub module README hu tawm cov ntaub ntawv qhia tseeb.
auth.h8_c: Lub "Account enumeration resistance" mechanism tau hloov zuj zus thoob plaws Vortex tso tawm. Cov qauv tsim rov qab mus rau luam tawm kev tshawb fawb thiab kev tsim khoom ntawm cov tub txib ua ntej. Version keeb kwm nyob rau hauv 'CHANGELOG.md' cov ntaub ntawv thaum txhua daim tsaws thiab dab tsi txhawb nws.

rooms.title: Chav thiab kev xa xov
rooms.subtitle: Plaub hom chav, kev ua tswv cuab, kev sib hloov tseem ceeb, cov lus.
rooms.intro: Tag nrho plaub chav tsev — DM, pab pawg ntiag tug, pab pawg pej xeem, channel — qhia ib qho hauv qab 'chav' rooj. Cwj pwm yog gated los ntawm boolean chij.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: raws nraim ob tug tswvcuab, `is_dm=true`, `is_private=true`. Lub npe auto-set rau lwm tus tswv cuab tus tuav.
rooms.h1p2: **Private group**: caw-tsuas, `is_private=true`, `is_channel=false`. Max 5000 cov tswv cuab los ntawm lub neej ntawd.
rooms.h1p3: **Public group**: `is_private=false`. Txhua tus uas muaj qhov txuas caw tuaj yeem koom nrog; teev nyob rau hauv pej xeem directory yog tus tswv xaiv nyob rau hauv.
rooms.h1p4: **Channel**: broadcast-only, `is_channel=true`. Tsuas yog tus tswv/admins tuaj yeem tshaj tawm; cov tswv cuab niaj hnub nyeem.
rooms.h2: Kev ua tswv cuab thiab lub luag haujlwm
rooms.h2p1: Lub luag haujlwm: 'tus tswv', 'admin', 'tus tswv cuab'. Tsuas yog ib tus tswv rau ib chav (ua tau).
rooms.h2p2: Admins tuaj yeem caw, ncaws, kaw lus, thiab hloov kho chav. Cov tswv cuab tuaj yeem xa cov lus, teb, kho tus kheej, tshem tawm tus kheej.
rooms.h2p3: Tso cai cascade: cov tswv muaj txhua lub hwj chim admin. Admins tsis tuaj yeem demote tus tswv.
rooms.h2p4: Lub luag haujlwm hloov pauv tsim cov lus kaw lus (`zoo: "role_changed"`) pom rau txhua tus tswv cuab.
rooms.h3p1: Txhua chav muaj 32-byte ** hauv paus yuam sij ** tsim los ntawm kev tsim ntawm 'secrets.token_bytes(32)' ntawm tus tsim lub cuab yeej.
rooms.h3p2: Txhua tus tswvcuab tau txais ib lub hnab ntawv `{member_id, hnab ntawv: X25519_encrypt(member_pubkey, root_key)}` khaws cia hauv `room_keys`.
rooms.h3p3: Thaum ib tug tswv cuab koom nrog, ib lub hnab ntawv tshiab yog minted rau lawv los ntawm ib tug neeg uas twb muaj lawm tus neeg siv khoom. Lub hnab ntawv minting yog O (1) rau kev koom ua ke.
rooms.h3p4: Thaum ib tug tswvcuab tawm mus, chav rotates: tus tsim (lossis thawj tus neeg ua haujlwm nquag) muab cov hauv paus tshiab, rov qab lub hnab ntawv rau cov tswvcuab uas tseem tshuav, tshaj tawm `{ hom: "k", chav:..., new_envelopes: [...]}` ntawm WebSocket. Qub ciphertext nyob twj ywm nyeem tau nrog tus yuam sij qub uas cov neeg siv tseem muaj cached.
rooms.h3l1: Variant-B tseem ceeb tshaj tawm: rau cov chav pej xeem ntawm> 1000 tus tswv cuab, lub hnab ntawv nres scaling. Hloov chaw, tus tswv kos npe thiab tshaj tawm cov ntsiab lus hauv paus tam sim no hauv 'room_public_keys' rooj. Cov neeg siv khoom txheeb xyuas kos npe tawm tsam chav tsev tus tswv pubkey. Kev sib hloov ntawm cov tswv cuab tawm yog yog li tsis muaj kev xaiv rau chav Variant-B.
rooms.h3l2: Ib chav pseudo: txhua chav kuj muaj 'room_pseudo_salt'. Cov tswv cuab pseudonym nyob rau hauv cov lus yog "HMAC-SHA256(ntsev, user_id)" truncated rau 16 hex chars. Node tsis tuaj yeem qhia tus neeg siv xa xov twg yam tsis muaj tus neeg siv khoom-sab qhia.
rooms.h4p1: Cov lus muaj monotonic IDs ib chav (64-ntsis pib-increment, 'bigserial' hauv Postgres, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` hauv SQLite).
rooms.h4p2: Ordering yog server-assigned. Cov neeg siv khoom tsis sib ntaus sib tua dhau sijhawm; lawv ua nyob rau hauv ID kev txiav txim thiab qhia tus neeg xa ntawv lub sijhawm phab ntsa raws li UI metadata nkaus xwb.
rooms.h4p3: Kho kom raug: tshiab ciphertext hloov cov qub hauv qhov chaw, 'edited_at' hloov tshiab. Cov neeg siv khoom pom '(edited)' cim.
rooms.h4p4: Deletes: teem 'deleted_at', null out ciphertext. `{type:"m", deleted:true}` tshaj tawm.
rooms.h4p5: Replies: `reply_to` = referenced message id. Cov neeg siv khoom muab cov ntawv sau me me.
rooms.h5p1: Cov tshuaj tiv thaiv yog kab hauv 'kev tshwm sim (message_id, user_id, emoji, tsim_at)'. Client POSTs `/api/messages/{id}/reactions/{emoji}`. DELETE rau un-reacts.
rooms.h5p2: Node kiv cua tawm `{hom:"m", cov tshuaj tiv thaiv:[...]}` rau txhua tus neeg siv. Cov neeg siv khoom sib sau ua ke.
rooms.h5p3: Tsis muaj kev txwv rau emoji - ib qho Unicode. Cov neeg siv khoom de-dupe thiab muab suav.
rooms.h6p1: Ib tug xov yog ib tug pseudo-chav rooted ntawm ib cov lus. `POST /api/messages/{id}/xov` tsim `{id: <new_room_id>, parent_message_id: <msg_id>, parent_room_id: <original>}`.
rooms.h6p2: Cov chav xov tau txais kev ua tswv cuab los ntawm niam txiv. Txhua tus niam txiv hauv chav tsev tuaj yeem tshaj tawm rau hauv ib qho xov.
rooms.h6p3: Key derivation: xov root key = `HKDF(parent_root, info: "xov:" + <parent_message_id>, len: 32)`. Kev sib haum xeeb ntawm cov xov tseem ceeb tsis xau niam txiv.
rooms.h7p1: Admins tuaj yeem pin txog 10 cov lus hauv ib chav. `POST /api/rooms/{id}/pin` nrog `{message_id}`.
rooms.h7p2: Pinned teeb yog loaded rau ntawm chav qhib; Cov neeg siv khoom ua tus pinned header rau saum.
rooms.h8p1: Ib-chav cov ntawv sau txuas ntxiv mus rau ntawm qhov no: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` nrog `{text}`. `GET` rov qab tam sim no. `DELETE` clears.
rooms.h8p2: Cov neeg siv khoom sync cov ntawv sau thoob plaws cov khoom siv yog li ntaus ntawv hauv xov tooj ua tiav ntawm lub desktop. Cov ntawv sau tsis yog qhov kawg-rau-kawg encrypted - lawv yog server-pom cov ntawv nyeem. Qhov ntawd yog kev txhob txwm ua lag luam rau kev sib tw khoom UX. Cov neeg siv khoom tuaj yeem cuam tshuam sync ib chav.
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/scheduled` nrog `{room_id, ciphertext, send_at}`. Node khw hauv 'scheduled_messages'; tus neeg ua haujlwm cron ua haujlwm raws sijhawm.
rooms.h9p2: Kho tau thiab tshem tawm kom txog thaum send_at zuam hluav taws. Tom qab xa, cov lus yuav dhau los ua kab hauv 'lus'.
rooms.h1_a: Tag nrho plaub chav tsev (DM, pab pawg neeg ntiag tug, pab pawg pej xeem, channel) sib koom ib 'chav' rooj. Qhov txawv yog nyob rau hauv peb tus chij boolean.
rooms.h1_b: Chij: 'is_dm', 'is_private', 'is_channel'. DM: is_dm=true, is_private=true, raws nraim 2 tus tswv cuab. Cov pab pawg ntiag tug: is_private=true, is_channel=false, mus txog 5000 tus tswv cuab. Public pab pawg: is_private=false, teev nyob rau hauv phau ntawv yog tus tswv opts nyob rau hauv. Channel: is_channel=true, tsuas yog tswv/admins ncej. Txhua tus qhia txog kev tswj hwm qhov tseem ceeb, kiv cua tawm, kev tawm tsam, xov.
rooms.h1_c: Ib lub rooj polymorphism yog ib qho qauv los ntawm Martin Fowler's *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002). Telegram siv peb chav sib cais sab hauv; Slack siv channels + DMs + multi-party DMs raws li plaub hom; Discord siv "channels" rau txhua yam. Peb xaiv ib lub rooj tom qab profiling pom tus nqi tseem ceeb yog tus kiv cua-tawm (uas yog ib yam ntawm cov hom) thiab tom qab v0.0.3 refactor merged peb lub rooj zoo sib xws rau hauv ib qho.
rooms.h1_f:

rooms.h2_a: Lub luag haujlwm yog peb-tier: tus tswv, admin, tus tswv cuab. Raws nraim ib tus tswv hauv ib chav, tsawg kawg yog ib tus thawj tswj hwm, arbitrarily ntau tus tswv cuab.
rooms.h2_b: `room_members(room_id, user_id, luag hauj lwm, joined_at, muted_until)`. Lub luag haujlwm cascade: cov tswv muaj txhua lub zog tswj hwm. Admins tuaj yeem caw, ncaws, kaw lus, thiab hloov kho chav tab sis tsis tuaj yeem txo tus tswv. Cov tswv cuab tuaj yeem xa cov lus, teb, kho tus kheej, tshem tawm tus kheej. Tus tswv hloov ntawm `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` nrog `new_owner_id` — tus tswv qub poob rau admin.
rooms.h2_c: Tus tswv / tus thawj tswj hwm / tus tswv cuab yog tus tripartite IRC op / suab / tus qauv siv los ntawm 1988, tom qab tau txais los ntawm Slack, Discord, Telegram. Qhov kev xaiv tshwj xeeb kom muaj ib tus tswv (tsis ntau) yog los ntawm kev txiav txim siab raws li txoj cai: nyob rau hauv kev txiav txim nrog pab pawg neeg-txoj cai lij choj, muaj ib tus tswv meej meej ua kom yooj yim DMCA thiab cov kev thov zoo sib xws.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE room_members (

rooms.h3_a: Txhua chav muaj 32-byte symmetric root key. Cov tswv cuab tuav cov ntawv muab qhwv hauv qab lawv X25519 pubkey.
rooms.h3_b: Ntawm kev tsim, tus neeg siv khoom tsim 'root_key = secrets.token_bytes(32)'. Rau txhua tus tswv cuab, tus neeg siv khoom nkag mus rau 'root_key' hauv qab `X25519(tus tswv cuab_pubkey)` → lub hnab ntawv. Cov hnab ntawv nyob hauv 'room_keys(room_id, user_id, hnab ntawv)`. Thaum tus neeg siv koom nrog, txhua tus tswv cuab tam sim no tus neeg siv khoom mints ib lub hnab ntawv tshiab rau lawv. Thaum tus neeg siv tawm mus, tus tswv lossis thawj tus thawj tswj hwm ua haujlwm tig - tsim lub hauv paus_key tshiab, rov-pob ntawv rau cov tswv cuab ntxiv, tshaj tawm `{ hom: "k", chav:..., new_envelopes: [...]}` dhau WebSocket.
rooms.h3_c: Ib tug tswv cuab wrapping yog tus qauv Signal pioneered hauv 2014 rau nws pab pawg-v2. Matrix's Megolm siv qhov zoo sib xws "sender keys" mus kom ze. Vortex tau mus nrog ib lub hnab ntawv rau ib tus tswvcuab vim nws yooj yim dua rau kev xav txog: tsis muaj kev cia siab rau pem hauv ntej ntawm cov neeg xa khoom. Kev lag luam tawm yog O(N) lub hnab ntawv minting ntawm kev hloov tswv cuab, uas yog qhov zoo txog ~ 5000 tus tswv cuab; pej xeem-channel Variant-B sidesteps qhov txwv.
rooms.h3_f:
ntawm tsim:
  root_key = rand(32)

thaum tawm mus:

rooms.h4_a: Variant-B tseem ceeb tshaj tawm hloov ib lub hnab ntawv nrog ib tus yuam sij kos npe, muab tso rau hauv lub rooj nyeem ntawv pej xeem. Scales rau 100k+ cov tswv cuab.
rooms.h4_b: Hloov chaw O(N) lub hnab ntawv minting, tus tswv kos npe rau lub hauv paus_key thiab tshaj tawm rau 'room_public_keys(room_id, key, signed_by, signed_at)`. Cov neeg siv khoom nqa, txheeb xyuas tus tswv lub Ed25519 pubkey, thiab siv. Kev sib hloov yog qhov tsis muaj kev hloov pauv rau kev ua tswv cuab - txhua tus uas muaj tus yuam sij tseem muaj nws txawm tias lawv tau raug ncaws tawm. Qhov ntawd yog qhov tsim nyog rau cov pej xeem tshaj tawm-txoj kev uas "keeb kwm tob" tsis yog tus qauv hem tab sis ncav cuag thiab ntsuas.
rooms.h4_c: Variant-B yog tus qauv ntawm Matrix's "lub ntiaj teb nyeem tau" keeb kwm pom tau ua ke nrog kev kos npe hloov pauv. Ntxiv rau Vortex hauv v0.0.8 tom qab beta muaj 50k-tus tswvcuab pej xeem channel uas nws lub hnab ntawv rov qab ua ntu zus tau tawg rau ntawm node. Txoj kev kos npe-thiab-tshaj tawm txoj hauv kev ntsuas linearly nrog cov kev hloov pauv tseem ceeb (uas tsis tshua muaj) es tsis yog nrog cov tswv cuab hloov pauv (uas yog tas li).
rooms.h4_f:
Variant-B:
  tus tswv kos npe: sig = Ed25519Sign(owner_priv, room_id ∥ root_key ∥ version)

rooms.h5_a: Caw codes yog 32 hex chars. Optional max_uses, expires_at, assign_role, revocable.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (admin-tsuas) tsim kab hauv `invites(code, room_id, created_by, max_uses, use_count, expires_at, assign_role, revoked_at)`. `POST /api/rooms/join` nrog cov lej kuaj xyuas siv tau (tsis tau tshem tawm, tsis tas sijhawm, siv_count < max_uses), nce ntxiv 'used_count`, tsim 'chav_cov tswvcuab' kab, rov qab chav metadata. rooms.h5_c: Caw cov lis dej num raws li lub hauv paus tseem ceeb yog qub li IRC's `+i` hom (1988). Telegram cov kev caw pej xeem txuas nrog tas sij hawm thiab siv txwv tsis pub dhau xyoo 2017. files.subtitle: Ib leeg txhaj tshuaj rau me me, rov ua dua rau qhov loj, tus neeg siv-sab encryption rau ob qho tib si.
files.intro: Txhua cov ntaub ntawv upload mus los ntawm tib lub raj xa dej encryption. Qhov sib txawv ntawm txoj hauv kev tsuas yog hais txog kev tiv thaiv lub network: resumable tolerates flaky links.
files.h1: Txoj kev txhaj tshuaj ib zaug upload
files.h1p1: Cap: 5 MB. Siv rau cov duab, suab sau ntawv, luv luv clips.
files.h1p2: Client encrypts tag nrho cov ntaub ntawv nrog AES-GCM, random 96-ntsis nonce, qhov tseem ceeb = `file_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)`.
files.h1p3: POSTs 'multipart/form-data' rau '/api/files' nrog teb 'file' (ciphertext), 'plain_blake3' (kev lees paub ncaj ncees), 'mime_type' (hint; server rov kuaj xyuas nrog 'python-magic').
files.h1p4: Node khw hauv qab `uploads/<category>/<sha256>.bin` thiab xa rov qab `{file_id, url}`.
files.h1p5: Client tom qab ntawd tshaj tawm cov lus hauv chav uas hais txog file_id thiab nqa cov file_root hauv nws cov ntawv ciphertext kom cov tswv cuab hauv chav tuaj yeem decrypt.
files.h2p2: Theem 1: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` nrog `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}`. Node faib tus ID upload, xaiv qhov loj me (default 512 KiB, capped ntawm 4 MiB), rov qab `{upload_id, chunk_size}`.
files.h2p3: Theem 2: rau txhua chunk, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` nrog raw ciphertext lub cev. Offsets yuav tsum tau ua raws li 'chunk_size'.
files.h2p4: Theem 3: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` nrog `{plain_blake3}`. Node reassembles, txheeb xyuas qhov loj me, khw muag khoom, rov qab `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2p5: Kev tuav tsis tau: cuam tshuam uploads tuaj yeem rov pib dua los ntawm kev tshaj tawm tsuas yog cov offsets uas ploj lawm. Node lem uas offsets tuaj txog hauv Redis (los yog hauv-nco rau SQLite hom).
files.h2p6: TTL: cov uploads tsis tiav yog purged tom qab 24 teev.
files.h3p1: Duab uploads (MIME `image/*`) ua rau lub hauv ncoo-raws li lub tshuab hluav taws xob ntawm 256 × 256 JPEG q=80. Khaws hauv qab `uploads/thumbs/<hash>.jpg`.
files.h3p2: Thumbnails kuj yog tus neeg siv-sab encrypted - tus neeg tau txais kev pab xav tau file_root los ua. Txuag bandwidth rau cov npe saib ua ntej.
files.h3p3: Video uploads (MIME `video/*`) ua rau ffmpeg-raws li daim ntawv tshaj tawm rho tawm ntawm 10% ntawm lub sijhawm clip, khaws cia tib yam.
files.h4p1: Client-xa 'mime_type' yog ib qho lus qhia. Tus neeg rau zaub mov khiav 'python-magic' tawm tsam thawj 1 KB thiab tsis lees paub yog tias hom sniffed nyob hauv daim ntawv tsis lees paub: `application/x-dosexec`, `application/x-sharedlib`, `application/x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: Qhov no txwv tsis pub cov neeg siv tsis ncaj ncees los ntawm kev xa tawm malware los ntawm tus xa xov. Motivated attackers tseem tuaj yeem hla nrog cov thawv ntim kom raug - kev tiv thaiv yog tus neeg siv khoom tsis kam lees, tsis yog server-sab sniff.
files.h5p1: Default: local filesystem. Good rau ib leeg-node deploys.
files.h5p2: S3: teeb `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...`. Cov ntaub ntawv yog streamed ncaj qha mus rau S3 yam tsis kov node lub disk. Presigned URLs yog siv rau downloads.
files.h5p3: 0⟫: kev sim. Uploads tshaj tawm CIDs los ntawm DHT; downloads nqa tej pinning node.
files.h1_a: Kev txhaj tshuaj ib zaug yog txoj hauv kev nrawm rau txhua yam hauv qab 5 MB - duab, suab sau ntawv, luv luv clips. Ib qho HTTPS POST, ib qho encrypted blob, ib kab hauv 'cov ntaub ntawv'.
files.h1_b: Client encrypts cov ntaub ntawv bytes kawg-rau-kawg nrog AES-GCM nyob rau hauv random 32-byte 'file_root'. POSTs 'multipart/form-data' rau '/api/files' nrog teb 'file' (ciphertext), 'plain_blake3' (kev lees paub ncaj ncees), 'mime_type' (hint). Node tswj lub 5 MB cap ntawm qhov tau txais qhov tsis sib xws, khiav 'python-magic' rau hom kev tshawb pom, tsis lees paub yog MIME nyob rau hauv daim ntawv tsis lees paub, khw muag khoom hauv qab 'uploads/<category>/<hash>.bin`, rov qab `{file_id, url, mime. Client ces tshaj tawm cov lus hauv chav hais txog 'file_id' thiab nqa 'file_root' hauv nws cov ntawv ciphertext.
files.h1_c: Lub 5 MB cap yog tib tus lej Slack thiab Telegram siv rau lawv txoj kev "inline" upload. Cov ntaub ntawv loj dua mus rau txoj kev rov pib dua. Thaum ntxov Vortex muaj 100 MB ib leeg-shot cap; peb poob mus rau 5 MB tom qab profileing pom tias ib leeg txhaj tshuaj uploads saum 5 MB muaj 40 % poob tus nqi ntawm cov xov tooj ntawm tes. Txoj kev resumable yog nruj me ntsis zoo dua rau cov ntaub ntawv loj txawm tias nws yog ntau roundtrips ntawm txoj kev zoo siab.
files.h2_a: Resumable upload yog txoj hauv kev rau cov ntaub ntawv loj. Client uploads tsau-loj chunks, tuaj yeem ncua, tuaj yeem rov pib dua ntawm txhua qhov chunk ciam teb, tuaj yeem rov qab los ntawm lub network blips.
files.h2_b: Peb-theem raws tu qauv. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` nrog `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}` → node allocates `upload_id` + lees paub qhov loj me. Chunks: rau txhua qhov offset, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` nrog raw ciphertext lub cev. Offsets yuav tsum yog ntau ntawm chunk_size. Finalise: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` nrog `{plain_blake3}` — node reassembles, txheeb xyuas qhov loj me + tag, khw muag khoom, rov qab `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2_c: Cov txheej txheem peb-theem yog tib yam li tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 multipart uploads, thiab Google Drive resumable uploads. Vortex tau txais tus.io zoo vim nws yog qhov sib tw yooj yim tshaj plaws rau FastAPI + streaming. Lub 24 h TTL ntawm qhov ua tsis tiav uploads ntais ntawv S3 lub neej ntawd thiab kev sib npaug rov pib ua kom yooj yim rau kev siv disk siv.
files.h3_a: Thumbnails yog generated server-sab thaum upload tab sis nyob encrypted nyob rau hauv tib cov ntaub ntawv hauv paus, yog li tsuas yog cov tswv cuab hauv chav tuaj yeem ua rau lawv.
files.h3_b: Rau `duab/*` MIME, Pillow tsim ib 256 × 256 JPEG q = 80 los ntawm decrypted saib ua ntej. Tos - tsis yog, tus neeg rau zaub mov yeej tsis muaj cov ntsiab lus tseeb. Kev khiav kom raug: tus neeg siv khoom tsim tus ntiv tes xoo hauv zos, encrypts nrog tib file_root + tshiab nonce, uploads raws li ib tug nus muag blob, thiab hais txog 'thumb_id' hauv chav lus. Server khaws cov ntawv ciphertext. Rau 'video/*', tus neeg siv khoom ua ib yam nrog ffmpeg-derived keyframe.
files.h3_c: Thaum ntxov Vortex muaj server-sab thumbnail tiam los ntawm cov ntawv dawb - peb tau tshem tawm qhov muaj peev xwm hauv v0.0.4 tom qab kev tshuaj xyuas kev nyab xeeb taw qhia tias nws ua txhaum E2E lav. Cov neeg siv ntiv tes xoo yog cov qauv teeb liab tau siv txij li xyoo 2018 thiab WhatsApp txij li xyoo 2020. Bandwidth tus nqi yog qhov tsis txaus ntseeg - 256 × 256 JPEG yog qis dua 20 KB.
files.h4_a: Tus neeg rau zaub mov tswj hwm MIME tsis lees paub cov npe ntawm cov sniff txheej kom tsis txhob cuam tshuam cov kev ua txhaum cai.
files.h4_b: Tom qab tag nrho upload (ib zaug-steev) los yog ua tiav (resumable), tus neeg rau zaub mov khiav 'python-magic' tshaj thawj 1 KB ntawm lub ciphertext lub thawv ntim khoom kom paub qhov tseeb. Yog tias sniff ceeb toom 'application/x-dosexec' (Windows PE), 'application/x-sharedlib' (Linux ELF), los yog 'application/x-mach-binary' (macOS Mach-O), upload is rejected with 415 Unsupported Media Type. Qhov no yog tus neeg rau zaub mov txoj cai, tsis yog ciam teb ruaj ntseg - tus neeg siv khoom hauv chav tsev tseem tuaj yeem nruab ib hom ntawv wrapper uas hla dhau qhov sniff.
files.h4_c: MIME sniffing raws li txoj cai tsis kam lees yog IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X los ntawm 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram txhua yam ua. Qhov kev txwv (zipped / ntim executables bypass sniff) tau paub txij li xyoo 2016 - peb qhov kev tiv thaiv yog txheej: ntxiv rau cov neeg siv-sab ceeb toom ntawm txhua cov ntaub ntawv nrog kev txuas ntxiv.

presence.h4p1: Tus neeg siv yog "online" yog tias lawv muaj tsawg kawg yog ib qho nquag WebSocket ntawm ib qho ntawm lawv cov khoom siv.
presence.h4p2: Pom tau rau cov neeg sib cuag nkaus xwb - tsis muaj kev sib cuag pom zaum kawg tab sis tsis yog qhov chaw nyob.
presence.h1_a: Qhov taw qhia ntaus ntawv raug xa los ntawm WebSocket ncej `{ hom: "t", chav tsev, xeev: "start"|"stop"}` thiab tshaj tawm los ntawm cov node rau txhua tus neeg siv hauv chav.
