presence.h1_c: Cov cim ntaus ntawv rov qab mus rau AIM / ICQ (1997). Niaj hnub nimno debounced designs taug qab rau Skype 2006 thiab iMessage 2011. Tus 3 s / 10 s tus lej yog los ntawm iMessage txoj kev coj cwj pwm - peb A / B sim 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 thiab 3/10 muaj qhov zoo tshaj plaws subjective "muab tib neeg atherosclerosis" tawm tswv yim.
presence.h2_a: Nyeem daim ntawv txais tos: tus neeg siv khoom POSTs nyeem ntawv kawg id; node khw hauv 'read_receipts' thiab tshaj tawm.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` with `{last_read_message_id}`. Node hloov tshiab 'read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` nrog UPSERT semantics. Tshaj tawm `{ hom: "r", chav, neeg siv, message_id, read_at}`. Cov neeg siv khoom ua "pom los ntawm N" hauv qab cov lus tawm. Tsis pub twg paub: tus neeg siv tuaj yeem kaw daim ntawv txais nyiaj nkaus xwb; ces cov node tsis pheej rau lawv AND lawv tsis pom lwm tus 'receipts (symmetric).
presence.h2_c: Cov ntawv txais nyiaj tau los ua txhua yam tom qab iMessage 2011 thiab WhatsApp 2014. Txoj cai symmetry (yog tias koj zais koj li, koj tsis pom lwm tus') yog los ntawm Telegram 2014 thiab yog tib txoj hauv kev kom tsis txhob muaj kev soj ntsuam ib leeg. Vortex tswj symmetry ntawm lub server - tsis yog tus neeg siv khoom nkaus xwb - yog li cov neeg siv dag txog tus chij tseem tsis tau pom dua.
presence.h3_a: Qhov kawg-pom yog ib daim ntawv teev sijhawm ib tus neeg siv, hloov kho ntawm txhua WebSocket thav duab thiab kev laus thaum tsis muaj thav ntawv tuaj txog.
presence.h3_b: Node lem 'presence.last_seen_at' as unix ms. Hloov kho ntawm txhua qhov kev lees paub WebSocket thav duab los ntawm tus neeg siv ntawd. Nyeem ntawm `GET /api/users/{id}/presence`. Sau npe los ntawm `{type:"sub_presence", user}` kom tau txais kev hloov pauv nyob. Granularity yog tus neeg siv-configurable: lub sij hawm raws nraim, sib npaug rau 5 min, sib npaug rau 1 h, "tsis ntev los no", los yog tawm.
presence.h3_c: Granularity tiers taug qab rau WhatsApp's 2012 kev ceev ntiag tug hloov tshiab tom qab kev tsis txaus siab txog qhov kawg-pom stalking. Telegram hauv 2013 ntxiv cov "tsis ntev los no / hauv ib lub lis piam / hauv ib hlis" thoob. Vortex lub 5 min / 1 h / "tsis ntev los no" echoes Telegram. Qhov kev xaiv "tawm" symmetrically hides tus neeg siv los ntawm pom lwm tus 'kawg-pom rau tib yam li cov ntawv txais nyiaj.
presence.h4_a: Qhov taw qhia online: tus neeg siv yog "online" yog tias lawv muaj tsawg kawg yog ib qho nyob WebSocket ntawm ib qho ntawm lawv cov khoom siv.

federation.intro: Federation cia cov neeg siv ntawm node A cov neeg siv ntawm node B. Nws yog opt-in rau ib tus neeg teb xov tooj. Node pubkeys ntseeg tau meej; tsis muaj qhov tsis siv neeg "txhua qhov node tuaj yeem koom nrog kuv" hom.

federation.h3p1: Yog tias B tsis tuaj yeem ncav cuag, A queues hauv 'federation_outbox(target_node, payload, sim, next_retry_at)'.
federation.h3p2: Exponential backoff: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, capped ntawm 6h. Ua tsis tiav tom qab 14 hnub.
federation.h3p3: Tus neeg teb xov tooj ceeb toom hluav taws kub thaum lub qhov tob tob> 1000 cov lus - qhia txog kev sib txuas ntawm tsoomfwv.

federation.h1_a: Federation nyob rau hauv Vortex yog kev sib nrig sib ntseeg kev sib raug zoo ntawm ob lub node tswv. Txhua tus ntawm luam tawm 32-byte Ed25519 pej xeem tus yuam sij; lwm qhov ntxiv nws mus rau 'trusted_nodes' lub rooj nrog rau nws qhov kawg thiab cov qhab nia noj qab haus huv.
federation.h1_b: Ntxiv cov pubkey uas ntseeg siab xav kom tus neeg teb xov tooj kos npe rau daim ntawv thov admin nrog rau ntawm tus kheej tso tus yuam sij. Lub UI qhia cov chaw taws teeb tus ntiv tes hauv daim ntawv 64-hex-char kom cov thawj coj tuaj yeem txheeb xyuas tawm ntawm pawg. Ib zaug ntxiv, txhua lub hnab ntawv hauv tsoomfwv tau txheeb xyuas qhov pubkey's Ed25519 kos npe - kev ua txhaum cai raug kuaj pom tam sim ntawd thiab nkag mus. Kev tshem tawm yog mos: kab nyob twj ywm cim 'revoked_at' rau kev tshuaj xyuas, tab sis lub hnab ntawv kos npe tam sim no ua tsis tiav.
federation.h1_c: Tus qauv yog muab los ntawm Matrix lub koom haum (qhov twg txhua tus neeg rau zaub mov tshaj tawm tus yuam sij kos npe thiab txhua qhov xwm txheej tau kos npe nrog nws) thiab los ntawm email DKIM (qhov twg DNS tshaj tawm qhov kos npe pubkey). Vortex qhov txawv ntawm qhov sib txawv los ntawm qhov yuav tsum tau muaj kev sib koom ua ke tsis pom zoo es tsis txhob Matrix's "txhua tus neeg rau zaub mov tuaj yeem koom nrog los ntawm txoj cai"; peb pauv kev yooj yim rau kev tiv thaiv muaj zog tiv thaiv lub koomhaum tsis ncaj ncees.

Tus neeg tau txais kev pab pom nws zoo ib yam li cov lus hauv zos - lub koom haum txheej tsis pom rau cov neeg siv kawg.

Thaum ntxov Vortex (v0.0.2) sim unsigned federation nrog TLS cov neeg siv ntawv pov thawj; peb hloov mus rau payload kos npe hauv v0.0.5 tom qab paub cov neeg siv ntawv pov thawj tsis muaj sia nyob load balancers thiab nkaum qhov tseeb qhov tseeb ntawm daim ntawv thov txheej.
federation.h3_a: Thaum cov chaw taws teeb tswj tsis tuaj yeem ncav cuag, tus xa ntawm cov kab ntawv hauv lub hnab ntawv hauv nws 'federation_outbox' thiab rov sim nrog exponential backoff.
federation.h3_b: Lub sij hawm rov qab: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, capped ntawm 6h. Kev vam meej tshem tawm kab; 14 hnub ntawm kev ua tsis tiav kos nws mus tas li thiab xa ib qho kev ceeb toom admin.
federation.h3_c: Exponential backoff nrog lub qab nthab yog tib tus qauv Kafka siv rau cov neeg tsim khoom rov ua dua thiab SMTP siv rau kev xa ntawv bounced. bmp.h1p5: Cov neeg tau txais kev pabcuam cov neeg siv khoom xaiv "GET /bmp/messages" thiab decrypts ib qho tshiab blobs nrog nws cov khoom tseem ceeb li ib txwm.
bmp.h2p1: Tsis muaj node tuaj yeem txuas lub blob mus rau tus neeg xa khoom - tus xa ntawv TLS kev sib txuas txheeb xyuas qhov chaw IP, tab sis cov saw ntawm dos hops ntawm tus xa thiab thawj BMP node tshem tawm qhov ntawd thiab.
bmp.h2p2: Tus neeg txais kev zais zais: blob yog encrypted nrog tus neeg txais tus pubkey. Cov nodes nruab nrab pom tsuas yog ib txoj hlua opaque byte thiab ib qho random mailbox_id.
bmp.h2p3: Tsis muaj kev lees paub kev xa khoom rau tus xa khoom. Feem ntau ib zaug semantics.
bmp.h3p1: Max blob loj: 1MB. Cov loads loj dua yuav tsum tau chunked los ntawm cov ntaub ntawv zoo tib yam.
bmp.h3p2: Max cia ib ntawm: 500MB ntawm cov nyiaj tso rau tag nrho. LRU ntiab tawm ntawm lub hau. Cov neeg ua haujlwm tuaj yeem kho tau.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: ib-IP deposit tus nqi txwv rau 10 / min. Mailbox IDs pom ntau dua 3 zaug / teev ntawm ib qho ntawm tus nqi txwv raws li kev xav tias dej nyab.
bmp.h4p1: Cov neeg tau txais kev censorship siab: tus neeg xa ntawv tsis tas yuav paub tus neeg txais kev pabcuam hauv tsev.
bmp.h4p2: Kev sib txuas tsis tu ncua: blobs tos kom txog thaum tus neeg tau txais kev sib txuas thiab kev xaiv tsa.
bmp.h4p3: Anonymous whistleblowing: sender-side dos + BMP = tsis muaj metadata ntawm leej twg tso dab tsi.
bmp.h1_a: BMP yog ib lub khw muag khoom tsis qhia npe thiab xa mus tom ntej. Tus neeg xa xov poob ib qho blob ntawm txhua qhov kev hais lus tsis txaus ntseeg; lub blob tos nyob rau hauv ib lub mailbox keyed tsuas yog rau tus neeg txais kev pab pej xeem tus yuam sij.
bmp.h1_b: Sender computes `mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Tsuas yog ib tus neeg paub 'recipient_pubkey' tuaj yeem suav nws - tus neeg txais kev paub, tus neeg xa ntawv paub, tus neeg thib peb tsis ua. Xa POSTs `{mailbox_id, blob}` rau txhua qhov kev hais lus tsis zoo. Node khaws cov khub mus txog 7200 s (2 h), thiab tshaj tawm lub mailbox_id nyob rau hauv cov lus xaiv tom ntej Bloom lim. Lwm cov nodes pom lub mailbox_id hauv zos txuam nrog tus neeg siv lub mailbox cached rub lub blob thiab xa mus rau tus neeg siv tus neeg siv khoom.
bmp.h1_c: BMP tau tsim los ntawm kos los ntawm pab pawg Vortex. Peb tsim nws vim tias tsis muaj tus xa xov tseem ceeb txaus siab siv cov peev txheej uas yuav tsum tau zais metadata kawg-rau-kawg - txhua yam khoom loj xa tawm cov ntsiab lus encryption tab sis sab laug cov txheej txheem xa tawm, yog li tus neeg rau zaub mov tseem paub tias leej twg tham nrog leej twg thiab thaum twg. Hauv pab pawg peb tau hais tias "tus tub txib ruaj ntseg uas xau cov duab sib raug zoo tsuas yog ib nrab ntawm kev nyab xeeb." BMP yog peb cov lus teb: tus neeg xa khoom, tus neeg txais, thiab cov ntsiab lus tag nrho ua opaque; tsis muaj ib qho ntawm lub mesh tuav cov khoom txaus los tsim kev sib tham. Nws khiav dhau Vortex tus kheej cov ntaub ntawv hais lus es tsis yog bolted-on infrastructure, uas yog dab tsi ua rau tus nqi lag luam tsim nyog thiab tsim kev soj ntsuam hauv tsev.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, info="bmp-v1", len=32)

Deposit: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Tshaj tawm: lus xaiv Bloom lim += mailbox_id
Pickup: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd) → blobs rau tus neeg siv lub mailbox_ids
TTL: 7200 s |  per-node cia cap: 500 MB |  Tus nqi tso nyiaj: 10 / min / IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP muab peb yam khoom ntiag tug ywj pheej: tus xa- nkaum, tus neeg txais- nkaum, cov ntsiab lus zais.
bmp.h2_b: Xa-pob zais: TLS kev twb kev txuas mus rau lub depositing node qhia qhov chaw IP; ntxiv Tor hop los yog cov dos-routed saw rau thawj BMP node tshem tawm qhov ntawd. Tus neeg txais kev zais zais: mailbox_id yog ib txoj kev hash ntawm tus neeg txais_pubkey ntsev nrog BMP version txoj hlua - qhov nruab nrab ntawm qhov pom tus cim opaque 32-byte. Cov ntsiab lus zais: blob twb E2E-encrypted rau tus neeg tau txais kev siv zoo tib yam Vortex chav / DM cov yuam sij, yog li qhov nruab nrab ntawm qhov pom tsuas yog ciphertext.
bmp.h2_c: Txoj kev tsim peb lub cuab yeej yog li cas Pond tau piav qhia nws cov hom phiaj hauv xyoo 2014. Vortex kho nws los ntawm kev ua lub mailbox_id kev sib tsoo-resistant (256-ntsis hash) yog li ob tus neeg siv tsis sib xws tsis tuaj yeem sib koom ib lub thawv ntawv. 7200-thib ob TTL los ntawm kev soj ntsuam tias 95% ntawm cov neeg tau txais hauv peb cov beta rub hauv 2 h; ntev TTL inflated per-node cia yam tsis muaj kev xa khoom pom tau zoo.
bmp.h2_f:
Tus yeeb ncuab uas pom lub xeev node:
  - paub mailbox_id muaj nyob rau lub sijhawm T
  - puas NOT paub tus neeg xa khoom (yog TLS / Tor hop deb)
  - puas NOT paub tus neeg txais (mailbox_id yog ib txoj kev hash)
  - puas NOT paub cov ntsiab lus (blob yog E2E-encrypted)
bmp.h3_a: Cov kev txwv nyuaj ntawm blob loj, ib-node cia, thiab tus nqi tso nyiaj khaws cia BMP los ntawm kev ua ib qho kev poob rau cov ntaub ntawv arbitrary.
bmp.h3_b: Max blob loj: 1MB. Kev them nyiaj loj dua yuav tsum chunk los ntawm cov ntaub ntawv zoo tib yam, uas muaj nws txoj hauv kev cia. Max per-node cia: 500 MB tag nrho ntawm BMP tso nyiaj. Thaum lub kaus mom mus txog, qhov qub tshaj plaws-thawj thawj zaug tshem tawm poob blobs ua ntej lawv TTL - cov neeg ua haujlwm tuaj yeem hloov kho ntawm 'BMP_MAX_BYTES' env var. Tus nqi tso nyiaj ib IP: 10 ib feeb, kom tiv thaiv dej nyab los ntawm ib tus neeg tawm tsam. Mailbox IDs pom ntau dua 3 zaug / teev nyob rau hauv lub network yog tus nqi txwv raws li "kev xav tias dej nyab lub hom phiaj".
bmp.h3_c: Lub 1 MB blob cap ntais ntawv IRC DCC-xa cov rooj sib tham thiab Lub Hwj Chim lub kaw lus-xa lub hau - loj txaus rau cov lus luv luv thiab cov duab me me, me me uas tus neeg tawm tsam siv tsis tau BMP rau cov ntaub ntawv hosting. 500 MB ib-node yog OSS-default sensible; Cov tswv lag luam loj tsa nws nrog 'BMP_MAX_BYTES'. Tus nqi txwv tuaj tom qab v0.0.8 beta qhov twg tus neeg xeem ntawv xeem ntawv sau 50 nodes nrog tso nyiaj hauv 20 feeb.
bmp.h3_f:
txwv:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 #1 MB
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # ib feeb ib IP
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # tib lub mailbox_id ib teev
bmp.h4_a: BMP ci nyob rau hauv peb qhov xwm txheej: cov neeg tau txais kev censorship siab, kev sib txuas tsis sib xws, tsis qhia npe xee suab.
bmp.h4_b: High-censorship: tus neeg xa ntawv tsis paub tus neeg txais kev pabcuam hauv tsev (thiab tej zaum tsis tuaj yeem ncav tsis tau). Tso rau ntawm ib tug phooj ywg, cia lus xaiv txoj kev. Kev sib txuas tsis tu ncua: tus neeg tau txais kev pabcuam offline rau teev; blob tos, tsis xav rov ua dua. Anonymous whistleblowing: sender-side dos + BMP = tsis muaj metadata txog leej twg tso dab tsi. Ua ke nrog ib qho tseem ceeb ntawm chav tsev tsuas yog paub rau cov neeg ntseeg siab xwb, cov ntsiab lus tseem opaque rau txhua tus neeg cuam tshuam.
bmp.h4_c: Peb qhov xwm txheej siv tau taug qab cov kev txhawb siab keeb kwm rau cov neeg tuag hauv lub cev espionage (Soviet-era), rau 'alt.anonymous.messages' ntawm Usenet (1990s), thiab rau SecureDrop (2013 txuas ntxiv). BMP yog peb txoj kev sim coj cov keeb kwm ntawd los ua tus xa xov xwm niaj hnub no yam tsis tas yuav muaj cov cuab yeej cais.

push.title: Nias cov ntawv ceeb toom
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Web Push — tag nrho nrog cov hnab ntawv kaw kom cov neeg muab kev pabcuam nyeem tsis tau.
push.intro: Cov kev pabcuam thawb tus qauv (APNs, FCM, Web Push) pom txhua qhov them nyiaj. Vortex qhwv txhua qhov kev ceeb toom nyob rau hauv ib txheej E2E cais kom tus neeg zov me nyuam pom tsuas yog ib qho opaque blob uas tsis muaj chav id, tus xa ntawv, lossis ntawv nyeem.
push.h1p1: Client tau txais lub platform token (APNs device token, FCM sau npe ID, lossis Web Push subscription JWT).
push.h1p2: Cov neeg siv khoom tsim tawm tshiab 32-byte X25519 yuam sij 'p256dh_pub' thiab 16-byte 'auth' zais cia. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` nrog `{endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform}`.
push.h1p3: Node persists `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_at)`.
push.h2p1: Thaum lub sijhawm ceeb toom (cov lus tshiab hauv chav kaw lus uas tau teeb tsa kom ceeb toom, hais, hu xov tooj), cov node encrypts lub payload nrog AES-GCM siv tus yuam sij los ntawm `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` ntawm HKDF.
push.h2p2: Node pob khoom `{endpoint, TTL, ceev, topic: <collapse_key>, data: <ciphertext>}` thiab xa mus rau APNs / FCM / Web Push server.
push.h2p3: Tus kws kho mob tsuas pom 'cov ntaub ntawv' (ciphertext) + 'topic'. Tsis muaj cov ntaub ntawv yooj yim xau.
push.h3p1: Ib-chav lub ntsiab lus tseem ceeb: `chav: <id>`. Ntau cov lus hauv tib chav tsev vau mus rau ib qho kev ceeb toom ntawm OS qib.
push.h3p2: Ib lub npe hu: `hu: <id>`. Teb lossis tsis kam rub tus chij; hu tshiab caw mus rau tib chav hloov tus qub.
push.h4p1: iOS: Ceeb Toom Service Extension decrypts hauv NSE txheej txheem (sib cais los ntawm lub ntsiab app). Siv tib yam CryptoKit primitives.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService decrypts hauv qhov kev pabcuam tom qab. JobScheduler teem sijhawm tiag tiag UI hloov tshiab thaum app yog foregrounded.
push.h4p3: Lub Vev Xaib: Tus Neeg Ua Haujlwm Pabcuam decrypts hauv SW cov ntsiab lus, tshaj tawm cov ntawv ceeb toom hauv zos ntawm Web Notifications API.
push.h5: Cov kws kho mob tshwj xeeb quirks
push.h5p1: APNs: xav kom tus kws kho mob token rov kho dua txhua 60 feeb. Token refresh yog automated ntawm Apple's `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 cov ntaub ntawv tseem ceeb.
push.h5p2: FCM: legacy HTTP endpoint deprecated; peb siv HTTP v1 kawg nrog OAuth2 cov ntaub ntawv pov thawj kev pabcuam. Kev sib hloov txhua 1 h.
push.h5p3: Web Push: VAPID cov yuam sij (ib qho keypair ib ntawm). TTL capped ntawm 28 hnub los ntawm feem ntau browsers.
push.h1_a: Cov neeg siv khoom sau npe rau cov khoom siv token (APNs/FCM/Web Push) ua ke nrog tus yuam sij tshiab X25519 pej xeem thiab 16-byte auth zais cia.
push.h1_b: Client generates `p256dh_priv = rand(32)` thiab `auth = rand(16)`. Derives `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` nrog `{endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, user_agent}`. Node persists `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_at, last_refreshed_at)`. Kev sib hloov: tus neeg siv tau rov sau npe rau ntawm txhua lub app tso tawm, uas ua rau 'last_refreshed_at'. Cov ntawv sau npe laus dua 30 hnub raug tshem tawm.
push.h1_c: P256dh + auth fields los ntawm Web Push RFC 8291 (2017). Peb rov siv lawv rau APNs thiab FCM txawm tias cov kev pabcuam no tsis xav tau cov ntawv kaw cia - ua li ntawd khaws ib txoj hauv kev hla txhua peb. Ua ntej v0.0.5 Vortex xa plaintext payloads los ntawm cov kev pabcuam thawb; Tom qab Apple xyoo 2022 thawb kev ceev ntiag tug hloov tshiab thiab qhov xwm txheej sib txawv uas qhov kev teeb tsa tsis raug FCM qhov project xau cov ntawv ceeb toom, peb tau txav txhua yam rau lub hnab ntawv kaw.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand(32)
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519
auth = rand(16)

POST /api/push/subscribe
  { endpoint, p256dh: hex(p256dh_pub), auth: hex(auth), platform }
push.h2_a: Thaum lub sijhawm ceeb toom, cov node encrypts lub payload yog li tsuas yog tus neeg txais khoom tuaj yeem nyeem nws. Cov kev pabcuam thawb (Apple / Google / Mozilla) pom tsuas yog ib qho opaque blob.
push.h2_b: Node xaiv ib qho ephemeral X25519 keypair. Derives `ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)`. Khiav HKDF(salt=auth, ikm, info="aesgcm", len=32) → key. Encrypts `{title, body, room_id, message_id}` as CBOR → AES-GCM nrog tus yuam sij muab tau + random 96-ntsis nonce. Xa `{endpoint, TTL, ceev, lub ntsiab lus: collapse_key, cov ntaub ntawv: ciphertext, aes128gcm: { ntsev, pub_ephemeral}}` rau APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Cov cuab yeej tau txais, txuas ntxiv / tus neeg ua haujlwm pabcuam khiav tib qhov tseem ceeb derivation hauv thim rov qab, decrypts, qhia kev ceeb toom.
push.h2_c: Lub kaw lus thawb yog ncaj qha Web Push Message Encryption spec los ntawm 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple's 2022 iOS 16 hloov tshiab ntxiv kev txhawb nqa thawj-chav rau kev ceeb toom kev pabcuam txuas ntxiv ua tus decryption; Android tau txhawb nqa nws ntawm FCM cov ntaub ntawv xov xwm rau xyoo. Vortex yog ib qho ntawm ob peb tus tub txib uas siv tag nrho cov dej ntws nrog tib txoj cai ntawm tag nrho peb lub platform - iOS siv 'NotificationServiceExtension', Android siv 'FirebaseMessagingService', Web siv cov neeg ua haujlwm pabcuam.
push.h2_f:
ephemeral_priv = rand(32);  ephemeral_pub = ephemeral_priv · G
ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(auth, ikm)
key = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Cov ntsiab lus-Encoding: aes128gcm\x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-Expand(prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt(key, nonce, payload)
xa { endpoint, data: ntsev∥record_size∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct }
push.h3_a: Kaw cov yuam sij tiv thaiv ntau cov ntawv ceeb toom los ntawm tib qhov kev sib tham los ntawm kev teeb tsa raws li tus kheej banners - OS coalesces lawv rau hauv ib qho.
push.h3_b: Per-room collapse: topic = `room:<id>`. APNs 'apns-collapse-id' thiab FCM's 'collapse_key' qhia OS hloov cov ntawv ceeb toom ua ntej nrog tib lub ntsiab lus. Tus neeg siv pom ib daim chij rau ib chav txawm tias muaj pes tsawg cov lus tuaj txog. Per-call collapse: topic = `hu:<id>`; hu tshiab caw mus rau tib chav hloov cov yav dhau los. Per-mention: topic = `mention:<user>:<room>`; ib tug hais banner rau ib tug neeg siv chav tsev khub.
push.h3_c: Tuav cov yuam sij tau ntxiv rau APNs hauv iOS 10 (2016) thiab mus rau FCM hauv 2014. Ua ntej ntawd, ntau cov lus tawg tau tsim ntau pawg chij uas cov neeg siv tsis sib xws. Telegram pioneered ib chav tsev vau UX xyoo 2015; txhua tus tub txib loj ua raws. Vortex tau muab faib rau hauv chav / hu / hais lub cev qhuav dej los ntawm cov neeg siv tswv yim hauv v0.0.6 beta uas "hu rau kev caw hloov banner sib tham" xav tias tsis yog - cais cov ntsiab lus kho nws.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-collapse-id = chav: 42 → hloov banners ua ntej
FCM: collapse_key = hu: 17 → hloov banners ua ntej
Web: topic = mention:u12:r5 → hloov cov banners ua ntej
push.h4_a: Txhua lub platform muaj nws tus kheej gotchas. iOS xav tau kev ceeb toom Service Extension; Android xav tau FCM cov ntaub ntawv xov xwm; Web xav tau tus neeg ua haujlwm pabcuam + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: lub pob app xa mus rau 'NotificationServiceExtension' lub hom phiaj. System xa cov encrypted payload rau lub NSE; NSE muaj 30 s ntawm CPU + 25 MB ntawm lub cim xeeb los txiav txim siab thiab hloov cov ntawv ceeb toom ua ntej nws tshwm sim. FCM: peb xa 'cov ntaub ntawv' cov lus (tsis yog 'kev ceeb toom') yog li lub app FirebaseMessagingService khiav thaum tuaj txog - uas ua rau peb tswj xyuas seb puas yuav qhia tus chij. Web Push: tus neeg ua haujlwm pabcuam cuam tshuam 'push' txheej xwm, decrypts, qhia ntawm 'self.registration.showNotification'.
push.h4_c: Tus qauv NSE tau qhia los ntawm Apple hauv iOS 10 (2016) tshwj xeeb rau kev siv cov lus-decryption. Ua ntej ntawd, kawg-rau-kawg encrypted messengers yuav tsum xaiv ntawm plaintext push payloads (privacy-hostile) thiab paib-tsuas pushes (UX-hostile). WhatsApp, Teeb Pom Kev, Telegram txhua tus dhia mus rau NSEs hauv ib xyoos. Vortex ua raws li tus qauv qub.
push.h5_a: Cov lus qhia tshwj xeeb ntawm tus kws kho mob - ib feem ntawm tshooj thawb. Qhov no yog ib qho ntawm cov txheej txheem tseem ceeb hais txog thoob plaws hauv Vortex siv. Nyeem tshooj nyob ib puag ncig rau cov ntsiab lus dav dav; ntu no zooms rau ntawm tus cwj pwm tshwj xeeb.
push.h5_b: Kev piav qhia txog kev siv rau "tus neeg muab kev pabcuam tshwj xeeb quirks". Cov txheej txheem yog siv nyob rau hauv cov coj module nyob rau hauv 'app/', 'ios/Modules/Sources/', los yog 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Lub module README hu tawm cov ntaub ntawv qhia tseeb.
push.h5_c: Cov txheej txheem "Cov Kev Pabcuam tshwj xeeb" tau hloov kho thoob plaws Vortex tso tawm. Cov qauv tsim rov qab mus rau luam tawm kev tshawb fawb thiab kev tsim khoom ntawm cov tub txib ua ntej. Version keeb kwm nyob rau hauv 'CHANGELOG.md' cov ntaub ntawv thaum txhua daim tsaws thiab dab tsi txhawb nws.

controller.title: Tswj kev pabcuam
controller.subtitle: Kev lees paub ncaj ncees, nkag mus nrhiav pom, saib xyuas kev noj qab haus huv.
controller.intro: Tus maub los yog tus txheej txheem cais Python. Nws qhov chaw nres yog me me (txog kaum ob txoj kev) thiab nws txoj kev ntseeg tau pinned rau ib qho Ed25519 pej xeem tseem ceeb ci rau cov neeg siv khoom.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/integrity` — kev lees paub. Schema: `{status, signed_by, trusted_pubkey, version, built_at, matched, mismatched, ploj lawm, ntxiv, lus}`.

controller.h2p1: Manifest file: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Muaj ib-file BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 kos npe.
controller.h2p2: Generation: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Nyeem cov yuam sij tso tawm los ntawm 'keys/release.key', taug kev tsob ntoo, sau manifest.
controller.h2p3: Kev pov thawj: tus maub los nyeem cov lus qhia thaum pib thiab sib piv rau disk. Startup tsis nrov nrov ntawm kev tsis sib haum xeeb.
controller.h3p1: Daim iav khiav tib tus maub los code nrog tib qhov tso tawm tseem ceeb theej dhau. Cov neeg siv khoom pom zoo ib yam 'kos npe_by' hla daim iav - ib txoj hauv kev los kuaj xyuas daim iav cuav yog sib piv pubkeys.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS tshaj tawm cov taw qhia rau ib qho ntawm ntau daim iav. Cov neeg siv khoom sim ua qhov tseem ceeb nrog lub sijhawm.

bots.h3p1: Public bots tuaj yeem xa mus rau lub khw. Cov kws tshuaj xyuas xyuas cov lej tsis yog phish, tsis spam, tsis xau cov ntaub ntawv siv.

Node tsim 'cov neeg siv' kab nrog 'is_bot=true', tsim ib qho Ed25519 keypair, xa rov qab tus kheej-key bot token rau tus tswv (pom ib zaug). webclient.h2_a: Offline hom: tawm sau kab rau IndexedDB; Tus neeg ua haujlwm pabcuam flushing thaum txuas rov qab.

Tus neeg rau zaub mov paub qhov sib npaug ntawm tus yuam sij idempotency thiab rov qab cov lus teb qub. Kev nyeem ntawv ua haujlwm offline - tag nrho cov ntawv ciphertext synced nyob hauv IndexedDB thiab decrypts hauv zos nrog cov yuam sij hauv nco.

security.title: Kev ruaj ntseg posture

aead.subtitle: Authenticated Encryption nrog cov ntaub ntawv sib txuas.
aead.intro: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) yog ib qho cryptographic primitive uas muab kev ceev ntiag tug thiab kev ncaj ncees hauv ib qho kev hu. Muab ib qho tseem ceeb, tsis yog, cov ntawv dawb, thiab xaiv cov ntaub ntawv cuam tshuam (AAD), nws tsim cov ntawv ciphertext + authentication tag xws li kev cuam tshuam nrog cov ntawv dawb, ciphertext, lossis AAD tsis ua pov thawj.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) yog ib qho cryptographic primitive uas muab kev ceev ntiag tug thiab kev ncaj ncees hauv ib qho kev hu. Muab ib qho tseem ceeb, tsis yog, cov ntawv dawb, thiab xaiv cov ntaub ntawv cuam tshuam (AAD), nws tsim cov ntawv ciphertext + authentication tag xws li kev cuam tshuam nrog cov ntawv dawb, ciphertext, lossis AAD tsis ua pov thawj.
aead.h1_b: Vortex's AEAD ib txwm AES-256-GCM. Lub AAD slot yog cov ntsiab lus uas tus neeg tau txais yuav tsum paub txiav txim kom raug (chav id, file id, offset). Kev khi AAD txwv tsis pub hla cov ntsiab lus rov ua dua - cov ntawv ciphertext los ntawm chav A tsis tuaj yeem decrypted li chav B.
aead.h1_c: AEAD raws li lub npe primitive traces rau Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois / Counter Mode) yog tus qauv tsim los ntawm NIST hauv SP 800-38D (2007). Ua lub neej ntawd AEAD hauv TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Txhua tus txheej txheem ruaj ntseg niaj hnub siv ib qho AEAD.
aead.h1_f:

AEAD.Dec(k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt or ⊥

waf.subtitle: Web Application Firewall.
waf.intro: A WAF yog cov khoom nruab nrab uas tshuaj xyuas HTTP thov thiab thaiv cov qauv paub tsis zoo (SQL kev txhaj tshuaj, kev hla mus, kev txhaj tshuaj template) ua ntej lawv mus txog daim ntawv thov code.
waf.h1_a: A WAF yog cov khoom nruab nrab uas tshuaj xyuas HTTP thov thiab thaiv cov qauv paub tsis zoo (SQL kev txhaj tshuaj, kev hla mus, kev txhaj tshuaj template) ua ntej lawv mus txog daim ntawv thov code.
waf.h1_b: Vortex's WAF khiav li 'app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware`. ~ 50 regex kuaj tawm tsam URL, lus nug, lub cev. Blocks `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$ where`, paub XSS qauv. Kuj tseem tswj hwm tus nqi thoob ntiaj teb txwv (1000 req / s), kev txwv rau ib txoj kev (nkag mus 10 / min, sau npe 5 / min), txwv ib tus neeg siv.
waf.h1_c: WAFs hnub rau mod_security (2002). Cloudflare's WAF (2014) commoditised tus qauv. Txhua lub vev xaib niaj hnub no xa cov kev kuaj xyuas ua ntej. Vortex's regex daim ntawv teev npe tau muab tso ua ke los ntawm OWASP Sab saum toj 10 kos npe.
waf.h1_f:
ntawm txhua qhov kev thov:
  rau cov qauv hauv SQLI_PATTERNS: yog pattern.search(url + query + body): tsis lees paub
  rau cov qauv hauv TRAVERSAL: yog pattern.search(url): tsis lees paub
  rau cov qauv hauv TEMPLATE: yog pattern.search(body): tsis lees paub
tus nqi-limit keyed los ntawm (IP, route, user_id)
waf.h3_a: tus nqi limiting, audit log, OWASP, SQL txhaj

x25519.subtitle: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman hla Curve25519 (RFC 7748).
x25519.intro: X25519 yog elliptic-kov Diffie-Hellman hla Curve25519 hauv nws daim ntawv Montgomery. 32-byte ntiag tug thiab pej xeem cov yuam sij, 32-byte qhia zais cia. Siv rau qhov kev pom zoo tseem ceeb.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 yog elliptic-kov Diffie-Hellman hla Curve25519 hauv nws daim ntawv Montgomery. 32-byte ntiag tug thiab pej xeem cov yuam sij, 32-byte qhia zais cia. Siv rau qhov kev pom zoo tseem ceeb.
x25519.h1_b: Txhua tus neeg siv khoom zoo li qub, txhua qhov kev sib tham tsis sib xws, txhua qhov kev sib txuas-push subscription hauv Vortex siv X25519. Kev siv Montgomery-ladder yog tas li-lub sij hawm thiab tiv thaiv cov chav kawm ntawm sab-channel tawm tsam uas plagued yav dhau los nkhaus.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 tau luam tawm los ntawm Bernstein (2005); standardized li RFC 7748 (2016) nrog lub npe X25519 rau DH variant. Txais los ntawm Cov Teeb Meem, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMessage, Chrome (post-quantum hybrid). Ubiquitous nyob rau hauv niaj hnub siv cryptography.
x25519.h1_f:
tus yuam sij ntiag tug: a ∈ [0, 2²⁵⁵) (32 bytes me-endian, clamped)
public key: A = a · G (32-byte compressed point)
sib koom: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, → HKDF input)
kev ua tau zoo: ~ 100 µs ib DH ntawm iPhone 11
x25519.h3_a: Ed25519, HKDF, Curve25519, Teeb liab raws tu qauv

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket kiv cua tawm sab hauv
websocketFanout.subtitle: Yuav ua li cas ib lub node xa ib qho kev tshwm sim rau ntau txhiab tus neeg siv khoom.
websocketFanout.what: Lub WebSocket kiv cua-tawm yog Python- haiv neeg ntawm cov neeg siv khoom tuav ib chav. Thaum cov lus tau tshaj tawm, tus kiv cua-tawm dispatcher iterates lub teeb thiab enqueues ib tug serialized thav duab rau txhua tus neeg xa ntawv queue.
websocketFanout.why: Ntxuam-tawm zam tsis pub N-daim ntawv tus nqi ntawm kev tshaj tawm: ib qho kev decryption ntawm tus neeg xa ntawv sab, ib qho serialized thav duab, N xa-queue pushes. Txhua lub zog yog O (1); tus nqi luam raug thawb mus rau lub ntsiav ntawm 'xa()' lub sijhawm ntawm xoom-copy buffers thaum OS txhawb lawv.
websocketFanout.where: Ua tiav hauv 'app/chats/fanout.py'. Cov theem sab saum toj 'FanoutRegistry' tuav 'dict[room_id, set[WebSocket]]`. Cov ntawv sau npe raug saib xyuas los ntawm 'asyncio.Lock'; nyeem yog xauv-dawb snapshots.
websocketFanout.how: Ntawm cov lus POST lub router hu 'await fanout.broadcast(room_id, payload_bytes)`. Txoj kev theej cov txheej txheem hauv qab lub xauv, tso tawm, tom qab ntawd rov ua cov ntawv theej tos 'ws.send_bytes(payload)` nrog rau lub sijhawm 1-thib ob ntawm ib lub qhov (socket). Lub sij hawm-tawm qhov (sockets) yog cim tsis zoo thiab purged.
websocketFanout.when: Txhua cov lus, cov tshuaj tiv thaiv, nyeem ntawv txais, ntaus ntawv qhia, hu rau lub teeb liab, thiab chav hloov pauv tseem ceeb ntws los ntawm tib tus kiv cua-tawm. Ncej loj yog bounded ntawm 64 KiB; loj payloads raug tsis lees paub thiab xa rov qab rau tus neeg hu xov tooj ntawm HTTP.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` — ib-subscriber xa queue qhov tob. Overflow poob tus ncej qub.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — sab sauv khi rau 'send_bytes'. Tshaj dhau ua rau lub qhov (socket) tsis zoo.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` — tsis kam kiv cua tawm ntawm chav loj dua qhov no. Cov chav loj loj siv hom channel thiab rub tus qauv hloov.
websocketFanout.fail1: Cov neeg siv khoom qeeb - ib lub qhov (socket) kab hla dhau. Cov ncej qub tshaj plaws poob. Client catches ntawm 'txij thaum' ntawm reconnect.
websocketFanout.fail2: Tuag qhov (socket) — 'xa_bytes' tsa 'ConnectionClosed'. Dispatcher tshem tawm ntawm lub teeb thiab txav mus.
websocketFanout.fail3: Cov neeg tsim khoom tawg - yog tias tus tsim khoom yog> 5 × nrawm dua li cov neeg siv khoom sib sau ua ke, rov qab-siab ncaws tawm ntawm 'tos' ncua tus neeg xa khoom.
websocketFanout.fail4: Lub cim xeeb tshuab - ib-subscriber queue capped ntawm 256 ntas; ntawm 64 KiB txhua tus uas yog 16 MiB max rau cov neeg siv khoom qeeb. Tus neeg siv khoom khiav tawm yuav raug cuam tshuam los ntawm kev kuaj lub neej ua ntej tsoo lub qab nthab.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus gauge `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{chav, neeg siv}` — per-socket queue qhov tob.
websocketFanout.mon2: Counter `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — poob thav ntawv los ntawm yog vim li cas (dhau mus, ncua sijhawm, kaw).
websocketFanout.tune1: Tsa 'FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE' rau cov neeg siv khoom ntawm cov tes hauj lwm qeeb tab sis ruaj khov.
websocketFanout.tune2: Txo qis 'FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS' nyob rau hauv cov kev sib cav sib ceg siab uas cov sockets qeeb tshaib plab rau lwm tus.
websocketFanout.tune3: Muab cov chav loj loj rau hauv cov chav me me lossis hloov lawv mus rau hom channel nrog rub-raws li hloov tshiab.
websocketFanout.edge1: Cov xwm txheej sib hloov chav (`hom: "k"`) raug xa nrog lub sijhawm 2 s tsis yog 1 s vim tias cov neeg siv khoom yuav tsum rov xa cov yuam sij ua ntej lees txais ntau cov lus.
websocketFanout.edge2: Cov xwm txheej ntaus ntawv tsis rov sim dua - poob "neeg siv nres ntaus ntawv" tsis muaj mob.
websocketFanout.edge3: Kev tshwm sim hloov tshiab yog batched: ntau tus neeg siv flips hauv tib lub qhov rais 250 ms yog coalesced rau hauv ib lub thav duab.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 siv ib-chav 'asyncio.Queue's — hloov nyob rau hauv v0.0.5 los ntawm lub xauv-copy-iterate qauv rau qis ib-lus CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Yav tom ntej: thaum Redis muaj, kiv cua-tawm yuav nyiam pub / sub yog li ntau pawg pawg rov ua dua cov xwm txheej yam tsis muaj mesh kiv cua-tawm.
websocketFanout.ts1: Tus nqi poob siab: xyuas lub network rau cov neeg siv khoom qeeb; pob qhov loj; tshawb xyuas tus neeg mob tus cwj pwm.
websocketFanout.ts2: Lub sijhawm xa tawm siab: yuav muaj TLS kev sib tham hauv kev ua tiav lossis NAT lub sijhawm dhau mus; tshawb xyuas kernel cav rau TCP retransmissions.
websocketFanout.ts3: Nco creep: tshuaj xyuas "vortex_fanout_queue_depth" rau ib tus neeg siv; cim txhua tus neeg siv nrog qhov tob tsis tu ncua> 200 raws li tus neeg siv yuav qeeb lossis siab phem.
websocketFanout.faq1: Q: Yuav ua li cas yog tias tus neeg siv khoom tsis tau thav duab thaum lub sijhawm txiav? A: Nws rov txuas nrog 'txij li=<last_seen_id>' thiab cov neeg rau zaub mov replays los ntawm DB. Cov kiv cua-tawm yog qhov zoo tshaj plaws-kev siv lub sijhawm tiag tiag; durability nyob rau hauv lub DB.
websocketFanout.faq2: Q: Tus neeg siv khoom siab phem puas tuaj yeem txo qis kiv cua tawm? A: Lawv qeeb lawv tus kheej cov kab, uas ua rau, poob thav ntawv, thiab txiav lawv. Tsis muaj kev cuam tshuam rau tus neeg siv khoom.
websocketFanout.faq3: Q: Kuv yuav ua li cas debug ib tus neeg siv khoom xa tuaj? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` dumps lawv cov kab qhov tob, xa ntawv zaum kawg, thiab cov tee tsis ntev los no.

nonceManagement.title: Tsis muaj kev tswj hwm
nonceManagement.subtitle: Yuav ua li cas Vortex khaws AES-GCM tsis muaj qhov tshwj xeeb hla cov khoom siv, chav, thiab rov pib dua.
nonceManagement.what: Txhua qhov kev ua haujlwm AES-GCM siv 12-byte tsis yog tias MUST yog qhov tshwj xeeb rau tus yuam sij muab. Rov siv lub nonce nrog tib tus yuam sij ua rau ob qho tib si tsis pub lwm tus paub thiab qhov tseeb - tus neeg tawm tsam nrog ob lub ciphertexts nyob rau hauv tib yam (qhov tseem ceeb, tsis yog) tuaj yeem rov qab tau cov ntawv dawb XOR.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex tsim ib chav yuam sij thiab siv nws rau ntau txhiab cov lus. Ib qho kev tsis sib haum xeeb nyob rau hauv ob cov lus yuav xau cov ntawv dawb. Tag nrho cov nonces yog li tsim nrog OS CSPRNG ntawm 96 khoom - thaj tsam hnub yug-kho-kev nyab xeeb yog li 2^32 cov lus rau ib tus yuam sij, ntau dua li ib tus yuam sij yuav nkag mus.
nonceManagement.where: Client-side nonce tiam nyob rau hauv `VortexCrypto` (iOS), `crypto/aead` module (Android), `app.security.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node). Lub node kuj khiav ib qho kev tiv thaiv duplicate-nonce check.
nonceManagement.how: Step-by-step: tus neeg siv khoom tsim 12 random bytes, hla mus rau AES-GCM encrypt, thav ntawv ciphertext li `{ciphertext, nonce}` thiab POSTs. Node records `(room_id, nonce)` nyob rau hauv lub cim xeeb LRU cache loj rau 10^6 nkag. Ntawm POST, node kuaj lub cache — duplicate ⇒ 400 'duplicate_nonce'. Nyob rau hauv ib txwm siv qhov no yeej tsis tua hluav taws (P (kev sib tsoo) ntawm 10^9 lus yog ~ 10^-19).
nonceManagement.when: Ntawm txhua qhov xa. Txais-sab: tsis muaj qhov kos - AES-GCM lub cim npe ua haujlwm ncaj ncees. Yog hais tias ib qho tsis tau rov ua dua, qhov thib ob decrypt tseem yuav ua tiav tab sis kev tsis pub lwm tus paub yuav raug cuam tshuam.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` - tus naj npawb ntawm cov nonces tsis ntev los no tau taug qab ib ntawm.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — cov ntaub ntawv qub raug tshem tawm tom qab 24 teev (feem ntau cov yuam sij tig hauv ib teev twg).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG tsis ua hauj lwm ntawm tus neeg siv khoom - tsis tshua muaj tshwm sim nrog OS-muab CSPRNG. Peb yeej tsis poob rov qab rau cov tsis-cryptographic RNGs.
nonceManagement.fail2: Cache nco ntawm node restart - tau txais vim cache yog kev tiv thaiv-hauv-qhov tob; cov neeg siv khoom yeej tsis raug cai rov siv cov nonces yog li lub nco tsis qhib qhov rai tawm tsam.
nonceManagement.mon1: Counter `vortex_nonce_duplicates_total{room}` — yuav tsum nyob ntawm xoom.
nonceManagement.mon2: Ntsuas 'vortex_nonce_cache_size' - yuav tsum nyob ib puag ncig cache cap.
nonceManagement.tune1: Cov chav loj: nce cache loj kom npog lub qhov rais ntev dua.
nonceManagement.tune2: Multi-node pawg: qhia cov cache los ntawm Redis thaum muaj.
nonceManagement.edge1: Cov neeg siv khoom offline rov txuas nrog cov lus queued: txhua cov lus queued yog nws tus kheej random nonce. Tsis xav tau kev sib koom tes.
nonceManagement.edge2: Multi-device xa: ob lub cuab yeej tsim kev ywj pheej random nonces. P(kev sib tsoo) ntawm 2 pab kiag li lawm × 10^4 lus = negligible.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 luv luv siv cov counter-raws li nonces seeded nrog ntaus id - deprecated tom qab ib daim ntawv qhia cross-device collisions nyob rau hauv lub moos-skew. Random-96 tam sim no tsuas yog txoj kev tau koob hmoov xwb.
nonceManagement.ts1: Saib 'duplicate_nonce' kev tsis lees paub: tshuaj xyuas tus neeg siv khoom buggy RNG; tshawb xyuas cov cuab yeej entropy qhov chaw.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: xyuas cache loj tiv thaiv chav sau tus nqi; yog tsa qhov loj los yog qis dua TTL.
nonceManagement.faq1: Q: Yuav ua li cas yog tias ob tus neeg siv khoom xaiv tib yam tsis yog los ntawm lub sijhawm? A: Ntawm 96 me ntsis ntawm randomness, xav tias thawj kev sib tsoo thoob plaws txhua tus neeg siv yog ntawm ~ 2^48 cov lus - ntau lub neej ntawm Vortex siv. Yog tias nws puas tau tshwm sim, node yuav tsis lees txais qhov thib ob.
nonceManagement.faq2: Q: Vim li cas 96 ntsis thiab tsis yog 128? A: AES-GCM tus qauv nonce ntev. 96 khoom kuj txuag 4 bytes ib cov lus.

keyRotation.title: Qhov tseem ceeb tig
keyRotation.subtitle: Thaum twg thiab yuav ua li cas chav tsev, ntaus ntawv, thiab tso cov yuam sij yob dua.
keyRotation.what: Txhua tus yuam sij nyob ntev hauv Vortex tig ntawm lub sijhawm lossis ntawm qhov ua rau. Cov yuam sij hauv chav hloov pauv ntawm kev ua tswv cuab los yog ncua sij hawm (ib lub lim tiam). Ntaus cov yuam sij tig ib tus neeg siv xaiv. Tso cov yuam sij tig thaum xav tias muaj kev cuam tshuam.
keyRotation.why: Kev sib hloov txwv lub blast radius ntawm kev sib haum xeeb. Ib tug nyiag chav yuam sij los ntawm nag hmo nres decrypting hnub no cov lus. Tus yuam sij tso tawm raug nyiag los ntawm 2024 nres ua pov thawj rau 2026 tso tawm.
keyRotation.where: `app/keys/` tsev server-sab rotation logic. Client side: `ios/…/Keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.swift`, `android/…/keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.kt`.
keyRotation.how: Kev sib hloov chav: txhua tus thawj coj tuaj yeem ua rau; zoo tib yam kev sib hloov ntawm kev tawm yog tsis siv neeg. Lub rotator muab cov hauv paus tshiab 32-byte, rov ntim hnab ntawv rau cov tswvcuab ntxiv, tshaj tawm `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` nrog lub hnab ntawv tshiab. Node atomically hloov kho 'room_keys' thiab tshaj tawm `{ hom: "k"}`.
keyRotation.when: Chav: tawm mus, ntawm tus thawj coj ua, txhua 7 hnub tau txais. Ntaus: txhua 90 hnub los ntawm lub neej ntawd (configurable). Tso Tawm: ad-hoc ntawm xav tias muaj kev cuam tshuam.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=true` — tua kom hla kev sib hloov ntawm kev tawm mus (tso kev ruaj ntseg rau qis dua CPU).
keyRotation.fail1: Client offline thaum lub sij hawm tig: catches up on next connect. Node khw muag khoom kawg 5 kev sib hloov yog li reconnects ib txwm pom lawv lub hnab ntawv.
keyRotation.fail2: Lub hnab ntawv minting haiv neeg: ob tus thawj tswj hwm tig ib txhij. Node lees txais thawj zaug thiab xa rov qab 409 Kev tsis sib haum xeeb rau qhov thib ob.
keyRotation.tune1: Cov chav pej xeem ntawm> 1000 tus tswv cuab: hloov mus rau Variant-B tseem ceeb tshaj tawm. Kev sib hloov ntawm kev tawm mus ua tsis muaj-op; cov tswvcuab tso siab rau pubkey kos npe tso tawm.
keyRotation.tune2: Lub sij hawm-sensitive chav (xws li kev sau xov xwm qhov chaw): luv luv cadence (txhua hnub lossis ib teev).
keyRotation.edge1: Chav tsev ib leeg tom qab tag nrho lwm tus tawm: kev sib hloov tsis tsim nyog tab sis tseem ua rau muaj kev sib xws; ib leeg tau txais ib lub hnab ntawv tshiab rau lawv tus kheej.
keyRotation.edge2: Tus tswv tawm: cov tswv cuab hloov mus rau qhov ntev tshaj plaws-joined admin; tus tswv lub hnab ntawv qub raug tshem tawm.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 tig tsuas yog tawm mus. v0.2 ntxiv ib ntus kev sib hloov tswj los ntawm `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS`.
keyRotation.ts1: Cov neeg siv khoom daig decrypting: kos lub hnab ntawv lub rooj; xyuas kom muaj kev sib hloov kev tshwm sim tau tshaj tawm.
keyRotation.ts2: Kev sib hloov tsis ua haujlwm: feem ntau yog network rau cov tswv cuab qeeb. Retry suav nkag rau hauv txoj kev tshawb xyuas.
keyRotation.faq1: Q: Puas yog kev sib hloov rov encrypt cov lus qub? A: Tsis yog. Qub ciphertext nyob hauv qab tus yuam sij qub; cov neeg siv khoom khaws cov yuam sij qub hauv lawv lub zos cache rau keeb kwm decryption.
keyRotation.faq2: Q: Yuav ua li cas yog tias tus neeg siv koom nrog thiab tawm sai sai 100 zaug? A: Txhua qhov kev ua rotates. Ntawm chav loj qhov no yog kim - peb ntsuas-txheej txheej koom ua tswv cuab rau 1 / min rau ib tus neeg siv.

rateLimiting.title: Tus nqi txwv
rateLimiting.subtitle: Ib-IP, ib tus neeg siv, ib-txoj kev token-bucket txwv.
rateLimiting.what: Kev txwv tus nqi yog qhov tseem ceeb tiv thaiv kev tsim txom ntau: brute-force login, sau npe dej nyab, lus spam, cov ntaub ntawv-upload tag.
rateLimiting.why: Tsis muaj kev txwv, txhua tus neeg ua phem pov thawj tuaj yeem tso tawm disk, saturate fan-out, lossis brute-force a 4-tus lej 2FA. Kev txwv yog pheej yig (~ 10 ns ib daim tshev) thiab tig lwm qhov kev tawm tsam tsis tseem ceeb rau hauv cov khoom kim.
rateLimiting.where: `app/security/limits.py` tuav lub limiter. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` yog ib daim ntawv nyias nyias rau kev lees paub.
rateLimiting.how: Token-bucket algorithm per (scope, key). Lub thoob refills ntawm tus nqi R, muaj peev xwm C. Thov siv 1 token. Lub thoob khoob ⇒ 429. Tracker cia: nyob rau hauv-nco dict ntawm ib leeg; Redis thaum `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Txhua qhov kev thov los ntawm WAF middleware. Hla daim ntawv teev cov khoom muaj nqis zoo li qub thiab kev kuaj mob.
rateLimiting.cfg3: `MSG_RATE_PER_USER=30` ib feeb rau ib tus neeg siv.
rateLimiting.cfg4: `FILE_UPLOAD_RATE=10` ib feeb rau ib tus neeg siv.
rateLimiting.fail1: Cov neeg siv raug cai tom qab sib koom NAT (chaw ua haujlwm, tsev kawm ntawv) hits per-IP txwv — tus neeg siv-tshaj 429 nrog cov lus coj zoo.
rateLimiting.fail2: Lub cim xeeb tawg ntawm qhov tawg loj - capped ntawm 100k cov yuam sij sib txawv; LRU ntiab tawm.
rateLimiting.mon2: Histogram 'vortex_rate_limit_check_duration_seconds' - yuav tsum nyob qis dua 100 µs.
rateLimiting.tune1: Qab ib CDN uas yog stripping tiag IP: teem 'TRUSTED_PROXIES' ces peb nyeem 'X-Forwarded-Rau'. Tsis tas li ntawd, tag nrho cov tsheb khiav mus txog qhov txwv nyob rau hauv CDN's egress IP.
rateLimiting.tune2: High-ntim bots: muab API tus yuam sij nrog `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000`.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: peb txwv ib / 64 es tsis yog ib-chaw nyob rau account rau loj ISP faib.
rateLimiting.edge2: Tor tawm: peb siv cov kev txwv looser (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) kom tsis txhob rau txim rau Tor cov neeg siv ntawm kev sib koom tawm.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 siv 'slowapi' nrog decorator-per-route — deprecated nyob rau hauv v0.0.5 rau nruab nrab nruab nrab.
rateLimiting.ts1: False-positive 429: tshawb xyuas lub npe tso cai config, tshawb xyuas kev sib koom-NAT teeb tsa, kev txwv tsis pub muaj kev txwv yog tias tsheb khiav raug cai raug ntaus nws.
rateLimiting.ts2: Bypassed: tshuaj xyuas cov ntaub ntawv nkag mus rau qhov kev tsim txom IP; ntxiv rau `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var rau kev thaiv nyuaj.
rateLimiting.faq1: Q: Puas yog cov kev txwv sharded hla cov nodes? A: Nyob rau hauv ib leeg-node hom, kev txwv yog per-node. Nrog Redis, kev txwv yog thoob ntiaj teb thoob plaws pawg.
rateLimiting.faq2: Q: Kuv yuav muab ntau npaum li cas rau kuv tus kheej? A: Cov neeg siv ntawv pov thawj tuaj yeem thov rau ntau dua quota ntawm `/api/admin/quota`. Admins pom zoo rooj plaub.

faq.p1: Q: Kuv puas tuaj yeem sau tag nrho app hauv Architex? A: Architex yog tsim los rau Mini Apps — cov ntxaij vab tshaus uas nyob hauv kev sib tham. Rau tag nrho haiv neeg app koj xav tau SwiftUI / Compose / React.
faq.p2: Q: Nws piv rau Flutter li cas? A: Flutter yog qhov dav dua tab sis muaj lub sijhawm ua haujlwm ntawm nws tus kheej (Dart VM + Skia). Architex yog me me thiab khiav ntawm tus tswv tsev primitives. Yog tias koj xav tau lub platform xauv-hauv, Flutter; Yog tias koj xav tau ncav cuag, Architex.
faq.p3: Q: Vim li cas ho tsis if thaiv? A: Vim tias hidden / visible modifiers npog 95%% ntawm UI conditionals ntau huv si. Rau lwm tus 5%, ternary qhia ua haujlwm.
faq.p4: Q: Puas yog Architex qhib qhov chaw? A: Yog — saib GitHub repo. MIT-licensed runtime, tsis muaj patent hlua.
faq.p5: Q: Kuv puas tuaj yeem hu xov tooj rau haiv neeg? A: Tsuas yog los ntawm tus tswv tsev-tso tawm built-ins lossis bot send() ua. Tus choj ncaj nraim yog txhob txwm tsis txhawb nqa - nws yuav ua rau kev txav mus los.
faq.p6: Q: Max screen complexity? A: Lub sijhawm ua haujlwm yooj yim tuav 10 k reactive hlwb thiab 100 k daim ntawv teev cov khoom. Tsis tas li ntawd, tawg rau hauv ntau qhov screen.
faq.p7: Q: Kuv puas tuaj yeem ua lub xeev? A: Yog, ntawm store(key, value) (ib-Mini-App hauv zos) lossis send(action: "save") mus rau bot (server-sab).
faq.p8: Q: Nws puas ua haujlwm offline? A: Yog rau cov ntxaij vab tshaus ntshiab-UI. Txhua yam hu send() xav tau lub network.
faq.p9: Q: Kuv yuav ua li cas ntxiv ib qho kev cai tivthaiv? A: Txawm li cas los xij @component hauv Architex, lossis (yog tias koj xav tau cov txheej txheem qub) pab txhawb rau Architex host pob.
faq.p10: Q: Kev ua tau zoo overhead vs txhais tes-sau haiv neeg? A: Feem ntau 3-8%% qeeb dua li kev sau ntawv SwiftUI / Compose. Tib neeg-imperceptible rau ib txwm cov ntxaij vab tshaus.
